name: Heights.Absolute.isIntegral
statement: theorem isIntegral (a : Qbar) : IsIntegral ℚ a
proof:
:=
  (AlgebraicClosure.isAlgebraic ℚ |>.isAlgebraic a).isIntegral

name: Heights.Absolute.coe_coords
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_coords (x : ι → Qbar) (i : ι) : (coords x i : Qbar) = x i
proof: := rfl

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_ringHom {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L] (φ : L →+* Qbar)
    (y : ι → L) : logHeight (fun i => φ (y i)) = Height.logHeight y / finrank ℚ L
proof:
:= by
  set x : ι → Qbar := fun i => φ (y i) with hx
  set M : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar := φ.toRatAlgHom.fieldRange
  let g : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] M := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField φ.toRatAlgHom
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ M := g.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hle : fieldOf x ≤ M := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y i, rfl⟩
  have h1 := Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).toRingHom (coords x)
  have h2 := Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank g.toRingEquiv.toRingHom y
  have hcomp : (fun i => (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).toRingHom (coords x i)) =
      fun i => g.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (y i) := by
    ext i
    rfl
  rw [logHeight, ← h1, hcomp, h2]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_eq_of_eq_comp
statement:
theorem logHeight_eq_of_eq_comp {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L] (φ : L →+* Qbar)
    {x : ι → Qbar} {y : ι → L} (h : x = φ ∘ y) :
    logHeight x = Height.logHeight y / finrank ℚ L
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact logHeight_comp_ringHom φ y

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem logHeight_eq_of_mem (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar) [FiniteDimensional ℚ F]
    (y : ι → F) : logHeight (fun i => (y i : Qbar)) = Height.logHeight y / finrank ℚ F
proof:
:=
  logHeight_comp_ringHom F.val.toRingHom y

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem {x : ι → Qbar} (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar)
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ F] (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ F) :
    logHeight x = Height.logHeight (fun i => (⟨x i, hx i⟩ : F)) / finrank ℚ F
proof:
:=
  logHeight_eq_of_mem F (fun i => ⟨x i, hx i⟩)

name: Heights.Absolute.finrank_pos_real
statement:
lemma finrank_pos_real (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar) [FiniteDimensional ℚ F] :
    (0 : ℝ) < finrank ℚ F
proof:
:=
  Nat.cast_pos.mpr finrank_pos

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_nonneg
statement: theorem logHeight_nonneg (x : ι → Qbar) : 0 ≤ logHeight x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (Height.logHeight_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem logHeight_zero : logHeight (0 : ι → Qbar) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : coords (0 : ι → Qbar) = 0 := by
    ext i
    rfl
  rw [logHeight, this, Height.logHeight_zero, zero_div]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_smul
statement:
theorem logHeight_smul (x : ι → Qbar) {c : Qbar} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    logHeight (c • x) = logHeight x
proof:
:= by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (insert c (Set.range x))
  have hcF : c ∈ F := IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hxF : ∀ i, x i ∈ F := fun i =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hcxF : ∀ i, (c • x) i ∈ F := fun i => F.mul_mem hcF (hxF i)
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxF, logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hcxF]
  have hc' : (⟨c, hcF⟩ : F) ≠ 0 := fun h => hc (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  rw [← Height.logHeight_smul_eq_logHeight (fun i => (⟨x i, hxF i⟩ : F)) hc']
  rfl

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_self
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_ringHom_self (σ : Qbar →+* Qbar) (x : ι → Qbar) :
    logHeight (fun i => σ (x i)) = logHeight x
proof:
:=
  logHeight_comp_ringHom (σ.comp (fieldOf x).val.toRingHom) (coords x)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_equiv (e : κ ≃ ι) (x : ι → Qbar) :
    logHeight (x ∘ e) = logHeight x
proof:
:= by
  change logHeight (fun j => x (e j)) = _
  have hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ fieldOf x := fun i => (coords x i).2
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem (fieldOf x) (fun j => hx (e j)), logHeight]
  exact congrArg (· / _) (Height.logHeight_comp_equiv e (coords x))

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_sumElim_zero
statement:
theorem logHeight_sumElim_zero (x : ι → Qbar) :
    logHeight (Sum.elim x (0 : κ → Qbar)) = logHeight x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∀ i, Sum.elim x (0 : κ → Qbar) i ∈ fieldOf x := by
    rintro (i | j)
    · exact (coords x i).2
    · exact (fieldOf x).zero_mem
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem (fieldOf x) hx, logHeight,
    ← Height.logHeight_sumElim_zero_eq (ι' := κ) (coords x)]
  congr 2
  ext (i | j) <;> rfl

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_le (f : κ → ι) (x : ι → Qbar) :
    logHeight (x ∘ f) ≤ logHeight x
proof:
:= by
  change logHeight (fun j => x (f j)) ≤ _
  have hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ fieldOf x := fun i => (coords x i).2
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem (fieldOf x) (fun j => hx (f j)), logHeight]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Height.logHeight_comp_le f (coords x)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_mul_table
statement:
theorem logHeight_mul_table {x : ι → Qbar} (hx : x ≠ 0) {y : κ → Qbar} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    logHeight (fun p : ι × κ => x p.1 * y p.2) = logHeight x + logHeight y
proof:
:= by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range x ∪ Set.range y)
  have hxF : ∀ i, x i ∈ F := fun i =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hyF : ∀ j, y j ∈ F := fun j =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hxyF : ∀ p : ι × κ, x p.1 * y p.2 ∈ F := fun p => F.mul_mem (hxF p.1) (hyF p.2)
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxF, logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hyF,
    logHeight_eq_of_forall_mem F hxyF, ← add_div]
  have hx' : (fun i => (⟨x i, hxF i⟩ : F)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, fun h => hi (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  have hy' : (fun j => (⟨y j, hyF j⟩ : F)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hy
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨j, fun h => hj (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  rw [← Height.logHeight_fun_mul_eq hx' hy']
  rfl

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_eq
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_eq (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar) [FiniteDimensional ℚ F] (b : F) :
    logHeight ![1, (b : Qbar)] = Height.logHeight₁ b / finrank ℚ F
proof:
:= by
  have h := logHeight_eq_of_mem F ![1, b]
  have hfun : (fun i => ((![1, b] : Fin 2 → F) i : Qbar)) = ![1, (b : Qbar)] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hfun] at h
  rw [h, Height.logHeight_swap, ← Height.logHeight₁_eq_logHeight]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_eq_gen
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_eq_gen (a : Qbar) :
    logHeight ![1, a] = Height.logHeight₁ (AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a) / finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯
proof:
:=
  logHeight_one_eq ℚ⟮a⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_nonneg
statement: theorem logHeight_one_nonneg (a : Qbar) : 0 ≤ logHeight ![1, a]
proof: := logHeight_nonneg _

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem logHeight_one_zero : logHeight ![1, (0 : Qbar)] = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := logHeight_one_eq ⊥ 0
  rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at this
  rw [this, Height.logHeight₁_zero, zero_div]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_inv
statement: theorem logHeight_one_inv (a : Qbar) : logHeight ![1, a⁻¹] = logHeight ![1, a]
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := logHeight_one_eq ℚ⟮a⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a)⁻¹
  rw [IntermediateField.coe_inv, AdjoinSimple.coe_gen, Height.logHeight₁_inv] at h1
  rw [h1, logHeight_one_eq_gen]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_neg
statement: theorem logHeight_one_neg (a : Qbar) : logHeight ![1, -a] = logHeight ![1, a]
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := logHeight_one_eq ℚ⟮a⟯ (-AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a)
  rw [IntermediateField.coe_neg, AdjoinSimple.coe_gen, Height.logHeight₁_neg] at h1
  rw [h1, logHeight_one_eq_gen]

name: Heights.Absolute.mem_adjoin_pair_left
statement: private lemma mem_adjoin_pair_left : a ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({a, c} : Set Qbar)
proof:
:=
  IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: Heights.Absolute.mem_adjoin_pair_right
statement: private lemma mem_adjoin_pair_right : c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({a, c} : Set Qbar)
proof:
:=
  IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_add_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_add_le :
    logHeight ![1, a + c] ≤ logHeight ![1, a] + logHeight ![1, c] + Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({a, c} : Set Qbar)
  set ba : F := ⟨a, mem_adjoin_pair_left a c⟩
  set bc : F := ⟨c, mem_adjoin_pair_right a c⟩
  have hsum : logHeight ![1, a + c] = Height.logHeight₁ (ba + bc) / finrank ℚ F :=
    logHeight_one_eq F (ba + bc)
  have ha : logHeight ![1, a] = Height.logHeight₁ ba / finrank ℚ F := logHeight_one_eq F ba
  have hc : logHeight ![1, c] = Height.logHeight₁ bc / finrank ℚ F := logHeight_one_eq F bc
  rw [hsum, ha, hc]
  have hle := Height.logHeight₁_add_le ba bc
  rw [totalWeight_eq_finrank] at hle
  have hd := finrank_pos_real F
  rw [← add_div, div_le_iff₀ hd, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne']
  linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_mul_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_mul_le :
    logHeight ![1, a * c] ≤ logHeight ![1, a] + logHeight ![1, c]
proof:
:= by
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({a, c} : Set Qbar)
  set ba : F := ⟨a, mem_adjoin_pair_left a c⟩
  set bc : F := ⟨c, mem_adjoin_pair_right a c⟩
  have hmul : logHeight ![1, a * c] = Height.logHeight₁ (ba * bc) / finrank ℚ F :=
    logHeight_one_eq F (ba * bc)
  have ha : logHeight ![1, a] = Height.logHeight₁ ba / finrank ℚ F := logHeight_one_eq F ba
  have hc : logHeight ![1, c] = Height.logHeight₁ bc / finrank ℚ F := logHeight_one_eq F bc
  rw [hmul, ha, hc, ← add_div]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Height.logHeight₁_mul_le ba bc) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: Heights.Absolute.abs_logHeight_one_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_logHeight_one_add_sub_le :
    |logHeight ![1, a + c] - logHeight ![1, a]| ≤ logHeight ![1, c] + Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := logHeight_one_add_le a c
  have h2 := logHeight_one_add_le (a + c) (-c)
  rw [add_neg_cancel_right, logHeight_one_neg] at h2
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.finrank_mul_logHeight_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finrank_mul_logHeight_eq_sum (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar) [FiniteDimensional ℚ F]
    {y : ι → F} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ F * logHeight (fun i => (y i : Qbar)) =
      ∑ w : InfinitePlace F, (w.mult : ℝ) * Real.log (⨆ i, w (y i)) +
        ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace F, Real.log (⨆ i, v (y i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [logHeight_eq_of_mem F y, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (finrank_pos_real F).ne', logHeight_eq_sum hy]

name: Heights.Absolute.finrank_mul_logHeight_comp_ringHom_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finrank_mul_logHeight_comp_ringHom_eq_sum {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    (φ : L →+* Qbar) {y : ι → L} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ L * logHeight (fun i => φ (y i)) =
      ∑ w : InfinitePlace L, (w.mult : ℝ) * Real.log (⨆ i, w (y i)) +
        ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace L, Real.log (⨆ i, v (y i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [logHeight_comp_ringHom φ y,
    mul_div_cancel₀ _ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (finrank_pos (R := ℚ) (M := L))).ne', logHeight_eq_sum hy]

name: Heights.Absolute.finrank_mul_logHeight_one_comp_ringHom_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finrank_mul_logHeight_one_comp_ringHom_eq_sum {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    (φ : L →+* Qbar) (b : L) :
    finrank ℚ L * logHeight ![1, φ b] =
      ∑ w : InfinitePlace L, (w.mult : ℝ) * Real.posLog (w b) +
        ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace L, Real.posLog (v b)
proof:
:= by
  have H := logHeight_comp_ringHom φ ![1, b]
  have hfun : (fun i => φ ((![1, b] : Fin 2 → L) i)) = ![1, φ b] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [hfun, Height.logHeight_swap, ← Height.logHeight₁_eq_logHeight] at H
  rw [H, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (finrank_pos (R := ℚ) (M := L))).ne',
    NumberField.logHeight₁_eq]

name: Heights.Absolute.mulHeight_eq_infPart_mul_finPart
statement:
lemma mulHeight_eq_infPart_mul_finPart {x : ι → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    mulHeight x = infPart x * finPart x
proof:
:=
  NumberField.mulHeight_eq hx

name: Heights.Absolute.prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings
statement:
lemma prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : InfinitePlace K → M) :
    ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, g w ^ w.mult = ∏ φ : K →+* ℂ, g (mk φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ mk (fun φ => g (mk φ))]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
  have : ∀ φ ∈ ({φ | mk φ = w} : Finset (K →+* ℂ)), g (mk φ) = g w := fun φ hφ => by
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hφ).2]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl this, Finset.prod_const, card_filter_mk_eq]

name: Heights.Absolute.card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq
statement:
lemma card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq (φ : k →+* ℂ) :
    #{ψ : K →+* ℂ | ψ.comp (algebraMap k K) = φ} = finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Algebra k ℂ := φ.toAlgebra
  rw [← AlgHom.card k K ℂ, ← Finset.card_univ]
  symm
  refine Finset.card_nbij (fun σ => (σ : K →+* ℂ)) (fun σ _ => ?_)
    (fun σ _ τ _ h => AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective h) (fun ψ hψ => ?_)
  · simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    ext x
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  · simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hψ
    refine ⟨⟨ψ, fun x => ?_⟩, by simp, rfl⟩
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ← hψ]

name: Heights.Absolute.prod_comp_algebraMap
statement:
lemma prod_comp_algebraMap {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : (k →+* ℂ) → M) :
    ∏ ψ : K →+* ℂ, g (ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) = (∏ φ : k →+* ℂ, g φ) ^ finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ (fun ψ : K →+* ℂ => ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)),
    ← Finset.prod_pow]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun φ _ => ?_
  have : ∀ ψ ∈ ({ψ | ψ.comp (algebraMap k K) = φ} : Finset (K →+* ℂ)),
      g (ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) = g φ := fun ψ hψ => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hψ).2]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl this, Finset.prod_const, card_filter_comp_algebraMap_eq]

name: Heights.Absolute.infPart_algebraMap
statement:
lemma infPart_algebraMap {ι : Type*} (y : ι → k) :
    infPart (fun i => algebraMap k K (y i)) = infPart y ^ finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [infPart]
  rw [prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings (fun w : InfinitePlace K => ⨆ i, w (algebraMap k K (y i))),
    prod_pow_mult_eq_prod_embeddings (fun w : InfinitePlace k => ⨆ i, w (y i)),
    ← prod_comp_algebraMap (fun φ : k →+* ℂ => ⨆ i, (mk φ) (y i))]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun ψ _ => ?_
  rw [← comap_mk]
  rfl

name: Heights.Absolute.absNorm_map_algebraMap
statement:
lemma absNorm_map_algebraMap (I : Ideal (𝓞 k)) :
    Ideal.absNorm (I.map (algebraMap (𝓞 k) (𝓞 K))) = Ideal.absNorm I ^ finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.absNorm_algebraMap, Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv
      (FractionRing.algEquiv (𝓞 k) k).toRingEquiv (FractionRing.algEquiv (𝓞 K) K).toRingEquiv]
  ext
  exact IsFractionRing.algEquiv_commutes (FractionRing.algEquiv (𝓞 k) k)
    (FractionRing.algEquiv (𝓞 K) K) _

name: Heights.Absolute.finPart_algebraMap_of_integral
statement:
lemma finPart_algebraMap_of_integral {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (z : ι → 𝓞 k) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    finPart (fun i => algebraMap k K (z i)) = finPart (fun i => (z i : k)) ^ finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : (fun i => algebraMap (𝓞 k) (𝓞 K) (z i)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz
    refine Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simpa using hi
  have h1 := absNorm_mul_finprod_finitePlace_eq_one (K := k) hz
  have h2 := absNorm_mul_finprod_finitePlace_eq_one (K := K) hz'
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => algebraMap (𝓞 k) (𝓞 K) (z i)) =
      (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).map (algebraMap (𝓞 k) (𝓞 K)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hspan, absNorm_map_algebraMap] at h2
  have hN : (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span (Set.range z)) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  have e1 : finPart (fun i => (z i : k)) = (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span (Set.range z)) : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
    eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1
  have e2 : finPart (fun i => algebraMap k K (z i)) =
      ((Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span (Set.range z)) : ℝ) ^ finrank k K)⁻¹ := by
    refine eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right ?_
    rw [← h2]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [e1, e2, inv_pow]

name: Heights.Absolute.exists_int_smul_integral
statement:
lemma exists_int_smul_integral (y : ι → k) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, d ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ z : ι → 𝓞 k, ∀ i, (z i : k) = (d : k) * y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hint⟩ := exists_integral_multiples ℤ ℚ (L := k) (Finset.univ.image y)
  refine ⟨d, hd, fun i => ⟨d • y i, ?_⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
  · exact (hint _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)))
  · simp [zsmul_eq_mul]

name: Heights.Absolute.mulHeight_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mulHeight_algebraMap (y : ι → k) :
    mulHeight (fun i => algebraMap k K (y i)) = mulHeight y ^ finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy
  · simp
  obtain ⟨d, hd, z, hz⟩ := exists_int_smul_integral y
  have hdk : (d : k) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have hdK : (d : K) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd
  have e1 : mulHeight y = mulHeight (fun i => (z i : k)) := by
    rw [← mulHeight_smul_eq_mulHeight y hdk]
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp [hz]
  have e2 : mulHeight (fun i => algebraMap k K (y i)) =
      mulHeight (fun i => algebraMap k K (z i)) := by
    rw [← mulHeight_smul_eq_mulHeight _ hdK]
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp [hz]
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hy
    refine Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, fun h => ?_⟩
    have := hz i
    rw [h] at this
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at this
    exact (mul_ne_zero hdk hi) this.symm
  have hzk : (fun i => (z i : k)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz0
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
  have hzK : (fun i => algebraMap k K (z i)) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hz0
    exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
  rw [e1, e2, mulHeight_eq_infPart_mul_finPart hzk, mulHeight_eq_infPart_mul_finPart hzK,
    infPart_algebraMap, finPart_algebraMap_of_integral z hz0, mul_pow]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_algebraMap
statement:
theorem logHeight_algebraMap (y : ι → k) :
    logHeight (fun i => algebraMap k K (y i)) = finrank k K * logHeight y
proof:
:= by
  rw [logHeight_eq_log_mulHeight, mulHeight_algebraMap, Real.log_pow, logHeight_eq_log_mulHeight]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank (f : k →+* K) (y : ι → k) :
    logHeight (fun i => f (y i)) / finrank ℚ K = logHeight y / finrank ℚ k
proof:
:= by
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  have h := logHeight_algebraMap (K := K) y
  rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] at h
  rw [h, ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ k K]
  have hk : (finrank ℚ k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr finrank_pos.ne'
  have hkK : (finrank k K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr finrank_pos.ne'
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_comp_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem logHeight_comp_ringEquiv (e : k ≃+* K) (y : ι → k) :
    logHeight (fun i => e (y i)) = logHeight y
proof:
:= by
  have h := logHeight_comp_ringHom_div_finrank e.toRingHom y
  have hfin : finrank ℚ k = finrank ℚ K :=
    (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) fun q => map_ratCast e q).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  have hk : (finrank ℚ k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr finrank_pos.ne'
  rw [← hfin] at h
  exact (div_left_inj' hk).mp h

name: Heights.Absolute.iSup_infinitePlace_pos
statement:
lemma iSup_infinitePlace_pos {x : ι → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    0 < ⨆ i, w (x i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (InfinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr hi) (Finite.le_ciSup_of_le i le_rfl)

name: Heights.Absolute.iSup_finitePlace_pos
statement:
lemma iSup_finitePlace_pos {x : ι → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (v : FinitePlace K) :
    0 < ⨆ i, v (x i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (FinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr hi) (Finite.le_ciSup_of_le i le_rfl)

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_eq_sum
statement:
theorem logHeight_eq_sum {x : ι → K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    logHeight x = ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, (w.mult : ℝ) * Real.log (⨆ i, w (x i)) +
      ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace K, Real.log (⨆ i, v (x i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [logHeight_eq_log_mulHeight, NumberField.mulHeight_eq hx,
    Real.log_mul (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun w _ =>
      (pow_pos (iSup_infinitePlace_pos hx w) _).ne')
      (finprod_ne_zero fun v => (iSup_finitePlace_pos hx v).ne'),
    Real.log_prod fun w _ => (pow_pos (iSup_infinitePlace_pos hx w) _).ne',
    Real.log_finprod fun v => iSup_finitePlace_pos hx v]
  simp only [Real.log_pow]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_comp_ringHom
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_comp_ringHom {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L] (φ : L →+* Qbar)
    (b : L) : logHeight ![1, φ b] = Height.logHeight₁ b / finrank ℚ L
proof:
:= by
  have H := logHeight_comp_ringHom φ ![1, b]
  have hfun : (fun i => φ ((![1, b] : Fin 2 → L) i)) = ![1, φ b] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [hfun] at H
  rw [H, Height.logHeight_swap, ← Height.logHeight₁_eq_logHeight]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_ratCast
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_ratCast (q : ℚ) :
    logHeight ![1, algebraMap ℚ Qbar q] = Height.logHeight₁ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [logHeight_one_comp_ringHom (algebraMap ℚ Qbar) q, finrank_self, Nat.cast_one, div_one]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem logHeight_one_one : logHeight ![1, (1 : Qbar)] = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := logHeight_one_ratCast 1
  rw [map_one, Height.logHeight₁_one] at this
  exact this

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_of_mem_aroots
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_of_mem_aroots {a r : Qbar} (hr : r ∈ (minpoly ℚ a).aroots Qbar) :
    logHeight ![1, r] = logHeight ![1, a]
proof:
:= by
  set φ := (algHomAdjoinIntegralEquiv ℚ (isIntegral a)).symm ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hφ : φ (AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a) = r := algHomAdjoinIntegralEquiv_symm_apply_gen _ _ _
  have := logHeight_one_comp_ringHom φ.toRingHom (AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ a)
  rw [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, hφ] at this
  rw [this, logHeight_one_eq_gen]

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_multiset_sum_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_multiset_sum_le (S : Multiset Qbar) :
    logHeight ![1, S.sum] ≤ (S.map fun s => logHeight ![1, s]).sum +
      Multiset.card S * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a S ih =>
    rw [Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.card_cons]
    have := logHeight_one_add_le a S.sum
    push_cast
    linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_multiset_prod_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_multiset_prod_le (S : Multiset Qbar) :
    logHeight ![1, S.prod] ≤ (S.map fun s => logHeight ![1, s]).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a S ih =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons]
    have := logHeight_one_mul_le a S.prod
    linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight_one_esymm_le
statement:
theorem logHeight_one_esymm_le (S : Multiset Qbar) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hS : ∀ r ∈ S, logHeight ![1, r] ≤ B) (m : ℕ) :
    logHeight ![1, S.esymm m] ≤
      2 ^ Multiset.card S * (Multiset.card S * B + Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  set n := Multiset.card S
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg one_le_two
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ (S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod,
      logHeight ![1, t] ≤ n * B := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp ht
    obtain ⟨hle, -⟩ := Multiset.mem_powersetCard.mp hu
    refine (logHeight_one_multiset_prod_le u).trans ?_
    refine (Multiset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ B fun x hx => ?_).trans ?_
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
      exact hS s (Multiset.subset_of_le hle hs)
    · rw [Multiset.card_map, nsmul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Multiset.card_le_card hle) hB
  have hcard : (Multiset.card ((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod) : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    rw [Multiset.card_map, Multiset.card_powersetCard]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_le_two_pow n m
  refine (logHeight_one_multiset_sum_le _).trans ?_
  have hsum : ((((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod).map
      fun s => logHeight ![1, s]).sum) ≤
      Multiset.card ((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod) * (n * B) := by
    refine (Multiset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ ((n : ℝ) * B) fun x hx => ?_).trans ?_
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
      exact hterm t ht
    · rw [Multiset.card_map, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hnB : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * B + Real.log 2 := by positivity
  calc _ ≤ Multiset.card ((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod) * (n * B) +
        Multiset.card ((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod) * Real.log 2 := by linarith
    _ = Multiset.card ((S.powersetCard m).map Multiset.prod) * (n * B + Real.log 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ n * (n * B + Real.log 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hnB

name: Heights.Absolute.logHeight₁_coeff_minpoly_le
proof:
:= by
  set p := minpoly ℚ a
  set n := p.natDegree
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg one_le_two
  have hn : n = finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ := (IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (isIntegral a)).symm
  have hC : 0 ≤ 2 ^ d * (d * max B 0 + Real.log 2) := by positivity
  rcases lt_or_ge n k with hk | hk
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hk, Height.logHeight₁_zero]
    exact hC
  set q := p.map (algebraMap ℚ Qbar)
  have hmonic : q.Monic := (minpoly.monic (isIntegral a)).map _
  have hqn : q.natDegree = n := natDegree_map _
  have hcoeff := coeff_eq_esymm_roots_of_splits (IsAlgClosed.splits q) (k := k) (hqn ▸ hk)
  rw [coeff_map, hmonic.leadingCoeff, one_mul, hqn] at hcoeff
  have hcard : Multiset.card q.roots = n := by
    rw [IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hqn]
  have hroots : ∀ r ∈ q.roots, logHeight ![1, r] ≤ max B 0 := fun r hr =>
    (logHeight_one_of_mem_aroots hr).le.trans (hB.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hes := logHeight_one_esymm_le q.roots (le_max_right B 0) hroots (n - k)
  rw [hcard] at hes
  have hsign : logHeight ![1, (-1 : Qbar) ^ (n - k) * q.roots.esymm (n - k)] =
      logHeight ![1, q.roots.esymm (n - k)] := by
    rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or Qbar (n - k) with h1 | h1
    · rw [h1, one_mul]
    · rw [h1, neg_one_mul, logHeight_one_neg]
  rw [← logHeight_one_ratCast, hcoeff, hsign]
  refine hes.trans ?_
  have hnd : n ≤ d := hn ▸ hd
  gcongr
  norm_num

name: Heights.Absolute.finite_setOf_finrank_le_logHeight_le
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_finrank_le_logHeight_le (d : ℕ) (B : ℝ) :
    {a : Qbar | finrank ℚ ℚ⟮a⟯ ≤ d ∧ logHeight ![1, a] ≤ B}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set C : ℝ := 2 ^ d * (d * max B 0 + Real.log 2)
  set T := {q : ℚ | Height.logHeight₁ q ≤ C}
  have hT : T.Finite := NumberField.finite_setOf_logHeight₁_le ℚ C
  have : Finite T := hT.to_subtype
  set P := {p : ℚ[X] | p.natDegree ≤ d ∧ ∀ k, p.coeff k ∈ T}
  have hP : P.Finite := by
    refine (Set.finite_range fun c : Fin (d + 1) → T =>
      ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), monomial (i : ℕ) (c i : ℚ)).subset ?_
    rintro p ⟨hpd, hpT⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨p.coeff i, hpT i⟩, ?_⟩
    change ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), monomial (i : ℕ) (p.coeff i) = p
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => monomial i (p.coeff i)),
      ← p.as_sum_range' (d + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hpd)]
  refine (hP.biUnion fun p _ => ((p.aroots Qbar).toFinset.finite_toSet)).subset ?_
  rintro a ⟨hd, hB⟩
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := minpoly ℚ a) ⟨?_, fun k => ?_⟩ ?_
  · rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (isIntegral a)]
    exact hd
  · exact logHeight₁_coeff_minpoly_le a hd hB k
  · rw [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_aroots]
    exact ⟨minpoly.ne_zero (isIntegral a), minpoly.aeval ℚ a⟩

name: Heights.Absolute.pow_natDegree_eq_neg_sum
statement:
lemma pow_natDegree_eq_neg_sum {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) :
    z ^ p.natDegree = -∑ i ∈ range p.natDegree, p.coeff i * z ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval z) hp.as_sum
  rw [hz, eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_finsetSum] at h
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h.symm

name: Heights.Absolute.natDegree_pos_of_root
statement:
lemma natDegree_pos_of_root {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) :
    0 < p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.natDegree with h | h
  · have := pow_natDegree_eq_neg_sum hp hz
    rw [h] at this
    simp at this
  · exact h

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_sum_le_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
lemma apply_sum_le_of_isNonarchimedean (hv : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → F) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, v (f i) ≤ M) :
    v (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hM
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    refine (hv _ _).trans (max_le (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) ?_)
    exact ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem apply_le_of_isNonarchimedean (hv : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hc : ∀ i < p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i) ≤ B) : v z ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  set n := p.natDegree
  have hn : 0 < n := natDegree_pos_of_root hp hz
  have hz1 : 1 < v z := lt_of_le_of_lt hB hlt
  have hz0 : 0 < v z := zero_lt_one.trans hz1
  have hsum : v (∑ i ∈ range n, p.coeff i * z ^ i) ≤ B * v z ^ (n - 1) := by
    refine apply_sum_le_of_isNonarchimedean v hv _ _ (by positivity) fun i hi => ?_
    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    rw [map_mul, map_pow]
    refine mul_le_mul (hc i hi') (pow_le_pow_right₀ hz1.le (by omega)) (by positivity)
      (by linarith)
  have heq := congrArg v (pow_natDegree_eq_neg_sum hp hz)
  rw [map_pow, AbsoluteValue.map_neg] at heq
  rw [← heq] at hsum
  have : v z ^ n = v z * v z ^ (n - 1) := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [this] at hsum
  have hpos : 0 < v z ^ (n - 1) := by positivity
  have := le_of_mul_le_mul_right hsum hpos
  linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem apply_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean (hv : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i < p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i) ≤ 1) : v z ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  apply_le_of_isNonarchimedean v hv hp hz le_rfl hc

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_max_one_iSup_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem apply_le_max_one_iSup_of_isNonarchimedean (hv : ∀ a b, v (a + b) ≤ max (v a) (v b))
    {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) :
    v z ≤ max 1 (⨆ i : Fin p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i))
proof:
:= by
  refine apply_le_of_isNonarchimedean v hv hp hz (le_max_left _ _) fun i hi => ?_
  exact le_max_of_le_right (Finite.le_ciSup_of_le (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin p.natDegree) le_rfl)

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_max_one_sum
statement:
theorem apply_le_max_one_sum {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) :
    v z ≤ max 1 (∑ i ∈ range p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i))
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (v z) 1 with h | h
  · exact le_max_of_le_left h
  refine le_max_of_le_right ?_
  set n := p.natDegree
  have hn : 0 < n := natDegree_pos_of_root hp hz
  have hz0 : 0 < v z := zero_lt_one.trans h
  have heq := congrArg v (pow_natDegree_eq_neg_sum hp hz)
  rw [map_pow, AbsoluteValue.map_neg] at heq
  have hsum : v (∑ i ∈ range n, p.coeff i * z ^ i) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ range n, v (p.coeff i)) * v z ^ (n - 1) := by
    refine (AbsoluteValue.sum_le v _ _).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    rw [map_mul, map_pow]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ h.le (by omega)) (v.nonneg _)
  rw [← heq] at hsum
  have : v z ^ n = v z * v z ^ (n - 1) := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [this] at hsum
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hsum (by positivity)

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_one_add_sum
statement:
theorem apply_le_one_add_sum {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) :
    v z ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ range p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (apply_le_max_one_sum v hp hz).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
  · linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg fun i (_ : i ∈ range p.natDegree) => v.nonneg (p.coeff i)]
  · linarith

name: Heights.Absolute.apply_le_max_one_mul
statement:
theorem apply_le_max_one_mul {p : F[X]} (hp : p.Monic) {z : F} (hz : p.eval z = 0) {B : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i) ≤ B) : v z ≤ max 1 (p.natDegree * B)
proof:
:= by
  refine (apply_le_max_one_sum v hp hz).trans (max_le_max le_rfl ?_)
  calc ∑ i ∈ range p.natDegree, v (p.coeff i) ≤ ∑ _i ∈ range p.natDegree, B :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hc i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    _ = p.natDegree * B := by simp

name: Heights.variableChange_invariantDifferentialDenominator
statement:
theorem variableChange_invariantDifferentialDenominator
    {F : Type*} [Field F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange F) (x y : F) :
    2 * (C.u ^ 3 * y + C.u ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) +
        W.a₁ * (C.u ^ 2 * x + C.r) + W.a₃ =
      C.u ^ 3 * (2 * y + (C • W).a₁ * x + (C • W).a₃)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_a₁,
    WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_a₃, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: Heights.variableChange_invariantDifferentialCoefficient
statement:
theorem variableChange_invariantDifferentialCoefficient
    {F : Type*} [Field F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange F) (x y : F) :
    (C.u : F) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (C.u ^ 3 * y + C.u ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) +
          W.a₁ * (C.u ^ 2 * x + C.r) + W.a₃) =
      (C.u⁻¹ : F) /
        (2 * y + (C • W).a₁ * x + (C • W).a₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableChange_invariantDifferentialDenominator]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]

name: Heights.ArchimedeanPeriodData.exists_variableChange_to_latticeCurve
statement:
theorem ArchimedeanPeriodData.exists_variableChange_to_latticeCurve
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) (v : InfinitePlace K) :
    ∃ C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange ℂ,
      C • W.map v.embedding = latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)
proof:
:= by
  apply WeierstrassCurve.exists_variableChange_of_j_eq
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.map_j, latticeWeierstrassCurve_j]
  exact p.j_eq v

name: Heights.ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_smul
statement:
theorem ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_smul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) (v : InfinitePlace K) :
    p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve W v • W.map v.embedding =
      latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (p.exists_variableChange_to_latticeCurve W v)

name: Heights.ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_differentialDenominator
statement:
theorem ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_differentialDenominator
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) (v : InfinitePlace K) (x y : ℂ) :
    let C
proof:
:= p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve W v
    2 * (C.u ^ 3 * y + C.u ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) +
        (W.map v.embedding).a₁ * (C.u ^ 2 * x + C.r) +
        (W.map v.embedding).a₃ =
      C.u ^ 3 * (2 * y +
        (latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)).a₁ * x +
        (latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)).a₃) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_smul W v]
  exact variableChange_invariantDifferentialDenominator
    (W.map v.embedding) (p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve W v) x y

name: Heights.ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_differentialCoefficient
statement:
theorem ArchimedeanPeriodData.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_differentialCoefficient
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) (v : InfinitePlace K) (x y : ℂ) :
    let C
proof:
:= p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve W v
    (C.u : ℂ) ^ 2 /
        (2 * (C.u ^ 3 * y + C.u ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) +
          (W.map v.embedding).a₁ * (C.u ^ 2 * x + C.r) +
          (W.map v.embedding).a₃) =
      (C.u⁻¹ : ℂ) /
        (2 * y + (latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)).a₁ * x +
          (latticeWeierstrassCurve (p.τ v)).a₃) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve_smul W v]
  exact variableChange_invariantDifferentialCoefficient
    (W.map v.embedding) (p.variableChangeToLatticeCurve W v) x y

name: Heights.nonempty_archimedeanPeriodData_of_modularJ_surjective
statement:
theorem nonempty_archimedeanPeriodData_of_modularJ_surjective
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective modularJ) :
    Nonempty (ArchimedeanPeriodData K W)
proof:
:= by
  choose τ hτfd hτj using fun v : InfinitePlace K ↦
    exists_mem_fd_modularJ_eq_of_surjective hsurj (v.embedding W.j)
  exact ⟨⟨τ, hτfd, fun v ↦ (hτj v).symm⟩⟩

name: Heights.nonempty_archimedeanPeriodData
statement:
theorem nonempty_archimedeanPeriodData
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic] :
    Nonempty (ArchimedeanPeriodData K W)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_archimedeanPeriodData_of_modularJ_surjective W modularJ_surjective

name: Heights.integralAt_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem integralAt_of_isIntegral
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) {W : WeierstrassCurve K}
    (h : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral (𝓞 K) W) : IsIntegralAt K v W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := h.integral
  constructor
  all_goals
    rw [hE]
    simp only [WeierstrassCurve.baseChange, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁,
      WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃,
      WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆]
    first
    | exact v.valuation_le_one (K := K) E.a₁
    | exact v.valuation_le_one (K := K) E.a₂
    | exact v.valuation_le_one (K := K) E.a₃
    | exact v.valuation_le_one (K := K) E.a₄
    | exact v.valuation_le_one (K := K) E.a₆

name: Heights.exists_reducedPrincipalIdealData
statement:
theorem exists_reducedPrincipalIdealData
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : K) :
    Nonempty (ReducedPrincipalIdealData K x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    exact ⟨
      { numerator := ⊥
        denominator := ⊤
        denominator_ne_bot := top_ne_bot
        numerator_ne_bot := fun h => (h rfl).elim
        zero_normalization := fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        coprime := (Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq).mpr (by simp)
        span_eq := by simp }⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, d, hnd⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ x
    have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
      intro hn
      apply hx
      rw [← hnd, hn, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, map_zero, zero_div]
    have hd : (d : 𝓞 K) ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d
    let N : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span {n}
    let Q : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span {(d : 𝓞 K)}
    let G : Ideal (𝓞 K) := N ⊔ Q
    have hN : N ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp hn
    have hQ : Q ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp hd
    have hG : G ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      apply hN
      exact le_bot_iff.mp (h ▸ le_sup_left)
    have hGN : G ∣ N := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr le_sup_left
    have hGQ : G ∣ Q := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr le_sup_right
    let A : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Classical.choose hGN
    let D : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Classical.choose hGQ
    have hNA : N = G * A := Classical.choose_spec hGN
    have hQD : Q = G * D := Classical.choose_spec hGQ
    have hA : A ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      apply hN
      rw [hNA, h, Ideal.mul_bot]
    have hD : D ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      apply hQ
      rw [hQD, h, Ideal.mul_bot]
    refine ⟨
      { numerator := A
        denominator := D
        denominator_ne_bot := hD
        numerator_ne_bot := fun _ => hA
        zero_normalization := fun h => (hx h).elim
        coprime := (Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq).mpr ?_
        span_eq := ?_ }⟩
    · apply mul_left_cancel₀ hG
      rw [Ideal.mul_sup, ← hNA, ← hQD]
      simp [G]
    · rw [← hnd, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div,
        ← FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton_div_spanSingleton,
        ← FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_span_singleton,
        ← FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_span_singleton]
      change (N : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) / (Q : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) =
        (A : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) / (D : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)
      rw [hNA, hQD,
        FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_mul, FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_mul]
      exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hG)

name: Heights.IsIntegralAt.valuation_c₄_le_one
statement:
theorem IsIntegralAt.valuation_c₄_le_one
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)} {W : WeierstrassCurve K}
    (h : IsIntegralAt K v W) :
    v.valuation K W.c₄ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let ν := v.valuation K
  have hconst (n : ℕ) : ν (n : K) ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using v.valuation_le_one (K := K) (n : 𝓞 K)
  have hb₂ : ν W.b₂ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.b₂]
    refine (ν.map_add _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · rw [map_pow]
      exact pow_le_one₀ bot_le h.a₁
    · rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_le_one₀ (hconst 4) bot_le h.a₂
  have hb₄ : ν W.b₄ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.b₄]
    refine (ν.map_add _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_le_one₀ (hconst 2) bot_le h.a₄
    · rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_le_one₀ h.a₁ bot_le h.a₃
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.c₄]
  refine (ν.map_sub _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
  · rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ bot_le hb₂
  · rw [map_mul]
    exact mul_le_one₀ (hconst 24) bot_le hb₄

name: Heights.exists_eq_exp_neg_nat
statement:
lemma exists_eq_exp_neg_nat
    {x : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h : x ≤ 1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, x = WithZero.exp (-(n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : WithZero.log x ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← WithZero.exp_le_exp]
    simpa [hx] using h
  refine ⟨(-WithZero.log x).toNat, ?_⟩
  rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hz)]
  simp [hx]

name: Heights.exists_integer_mul_of_dvd
statement:
lemma exists_integer_mul_of_dvd
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (x : K) (n : 𝓞 K) (d : (𝓞 K)⁰) (D : 𝓞 K)
    (hx : IsLocalization.mk' K n d = x) (h : (d : 𝓞 K) ∣ D) :
    ∃ z : 𝓞 K, algebraMap (𝓞 K) K z = algebraMap (𝓞 K) K D * x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨k * n, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div]
  simp only [map_mul]
  field_simp

name: Heights.exists_integralModel_change
statement:
theorem exists_integralModel_change
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (W : WeierstrassCurve K) :
    ∃ C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange K,
      WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral (𝓞 K) (C • W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n1, d1, h1⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ W.a₁
  obtain ⟨n2, d2, h2⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ W.a₂
  obtain ⟨n3, d3, h3⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ W.a₃
  obtain ⟨n4, d4, h4⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ W.a₄
  obtain ⟨n6, d6, h6⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (𝓞 K)⁰ W.a₆
  let d : 𝓞 K := d1 * d2 * d3 * d4 * d6
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
      (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d1) (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d2))
      (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d3)) (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d4))
      (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d6)
  let C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange K :=
    ⟨Units.mk0 (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K d)⁻¹
      (inv_ne_zero ((IsFractionRing.injective (𝓞 K) K).ne hd)), 0, 0, 0⟩
  have hd1 : (d1 : 𝓞 K) ∣ d :=
    ⟨d2 * d3 * d4 * d6, by simp [d]; ring⟩
  have hd2 : (d2 : 𝓞 K) ∣ d :=
    ⟨d1 * d3 * d4 * d6, by simp [d]; ring⟩
  have hd3 : (d3 : 𝓞 K) ∣ d :=
    ⟨d1 * d2 * d4 * d6, by simp [d]; ring⟩
  have hd4 : (d4 : 𝓞 K) ∣ d :=
    ⟨d1 * d2 * d3 * d6, by simp [d]; ring⟩
  have hd6 : (d6 : 𝓞 K) ∣ d :=
    ⟨d1 * d2 * d3 * d4, by simp [d]; ring⟩
  refine ⟨C, WeierstrassCurve.isIntegral_of_exists_lift (𝓞 K) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
  all_goals
    simp only [WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_def, C, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
      Units.val_mk0, inv_inv, add_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, zero_mul]
    try norm_num only [zero_pow]
    try simp only [sub_zero, add_zero, zero_mul]
  · exact exists_integer_mul_of_dvd W.a₁ n1 d1 d h1 hd1
  · exact exists_integer_mul_of_dvd W.a₂ n2 d2 (d ^ 2) h2
      (hd2.trans (dvd_pow_self d (by omega)))
  · exact exists_integer_mul_of_dvd W.a₃ n3 d3 (d ^ 3) h3
      (hd3.trans (dvd_pow_self d (by omega)))
  · exact exists_integer_mul_of_dvd W.a₄ n4 d4 (d ^ 4) h4
      (hd4.trans (dvd_pow_self d (by omega)))
  · exact exists_integer_mul_of_dvd W.a₆ n6 d6 (d ^ 6) h6
      (hd6.trans (dvd_pow_self d (by omega)))

name: Heights.exists_integralModel_change_rat
statement:
theorem exists_integralModel_change_rat (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) :
    ∃ C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange ℚ,
      WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral (𝓞 ℚ) (C • W)
proof:
:=
  exists_integralModel_change W

name: Heights.exists_localMinimalDiscriminantExponent
statement:
theorem exists_localMinimalDiscriminantExponent
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic] :
    Nonempty (Σ n : ℕ, IsLocalMinimalDiscriminantExponent K v W n)
proof:
:= by
  let ν := v.valuation K
  let R := ν.valuationSubring
  haveI : IsDiscreteValuationRing R := by dsimp [R]; infer_instance
  letI : Algebra R K := Algebra.ofSubsemiring R
  letI : FaithfulSMul R K := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R K).mpr (by
    intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R] using h)
  haveI : IsFractionRing R K := by
    apply IsFractionRing.of_field
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · exact ⟨0, 1, by simp [hx]⟩
    · by_cases hle : ν x ≤ 1
      · exact ⟨⟨x, hle⟩, 1, by
          simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R, map_one, div_one]⟩
      · have hinv : ν x⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [map_inv₀]
          exact (inv_le_one₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff ν).2 hx))).mpr
            (le_of_not_ge hle)
        exact ⟨1, ⟨x⁻¹, hinv⟩, by
          simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R, map_one, one_div, inv_inv]⟩
  let C := Classical.choose (W.exists_isMinimal R)
  have hC := Classical.choose_spec (W.exists_isMinimal R)
  let E := C • W
  haveI hmin : WeierstrassCurve.IsMinimal R E := hC
  have hint : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral R E := inferInstance
  have hcoeff : IsIntegralAt K v E := by
    obtain ⟨E', hE'⟩ := hint.integral
    constructor
    all_goals
      rw [hE']
      simp only [WeierstrassCurve.baseChange, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁,
        WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃,
        WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆]
      simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]
      first
      | exact E'.a₁.property
      | exact E'.a₂.property
      | exact E'.a₃.property
      | exact E'.a₄.property
      | exact E'.a₆.property
  have hΔne : ν E.Δ ≠ 0 := by
    exact (Valuation.ne_zero_iff ν).2 (by
      rw [show E = C • W from rfl, WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_Δ]
      exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (Units.ne_zero _)) W.isUnit_Δ.ne_zero)
  have hΔle : ν E.Δ ≤ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := WeierstrassCurve.Δ_integral_of_isIntegral R E
    rw [← hd]
    simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]
    exact d.property
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_eq_exp_neg_nat hΔne hΔle
  refine ⟨⟨n, C, hcoeff, hn, ?_⟩⟩
  intro D hD
  have hDint : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral R (D • W) := by
    apply WeierstrassCurve.isIntegral_of_exists_lift R
    · exact ⟨⟨(D • W).a₁, hD.a₁⟩, by
        simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨(D • W).a₂, hD.a₂⟩, by
        simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨(D • W).a₃, hD.a₃⟩, by
        simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨(D • W).a₄, hD.a₄⟩, by
        simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨(D • W).a₆, hD.a₆⟩, by
        simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]⟩
  let F := D * C⁻¹
  have hFEeq : F • E = D • W := by
    simp [F, E, smul_smul]
  have hFE : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral R (F • E) := hFEeq ▸ hDint
  letI : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral R (F • E) := hFE
  have hcan : WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R (F • E) ≤
      WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R E := by
    rcases le_total (WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R (F • E))
        (WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R E) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hm := hmin.val_Δ_maximal.2 hFE (by simpa only [one_smul] using h)
      simpa only [one_smul] using hm
  have hcan' :
      ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal R).valuation K) (D • W).Δ ≤
        ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal R).valuation K) E.Δ := by
    change
      (↑(WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R (F • E)) :
        WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) ≤
      (↑(WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux R E) :
        WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) at hcan
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux_eq_of_isIntegral R,
      WeierstrassCurve.valuation_Δ_aux_eq_of_isIntegral R] at hcan
    simpa only [hFEeq] using hcan
  have hequiv : ν.IsEquiv
      ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal R).valuation K) := by
    apply Valuation.isEquiv_of_val_le_one
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      let r : R := ⟨x, hx⟩
      simpa only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R] using
        (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_le_one
          (K := K) (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal R) r)
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_lift_of_le_one hx
      rw [← hr]
      simp only [Algebra.coe_algebraMap_ofSubsemiring R]
      have hrp := r.property
      change ν (r : K) ≤ 1 at hrp
      exact hrp
  rw [← hn]
  exact hequiv.le_iff_le.mpr hcan'

name: Heights.multiplicity_finset_product
statement:
theorem multiplicity_finset_product
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    (f : HeightOneSpectrum R → ℕ) (S : Finset (HeightOneSpectrum R))
    (hf : ∀ v, f v ≠ 0 → v ∈ S) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    multiplicity v.asIdeal (∏ w ∈ S, w.asIdeal ^ f w) = f v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : Ideal R := ∏ w ∈ S, w.asIdeal ^ f w
  have hI : I ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [I]
    change (∏ w ∈ S, w.asIdeal ^ f w) ≠ (0 : Ideal R)
    rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
    intro w hw
    exact pow_ne_zero _ w.ne_bot
  have hem := Finset.emultiplicity_prod v.prime S (fun w => w.asIdeal ^ f w)
  rw [← ENat.coe_inj, ← FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity
    (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left v.prime hI), hem]
  by_cases hv : f v = 0
  · rw [hv, ENat.coe_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    by_cases hiv : i = v
    · subst i
      rw [hv, pow_zero, emultiplicity_eq_zero]
      exact fun h => v.prime.not_unit (isUnit_iff_dvd_one.mpr h)
    · rw [emultiplicity_pow v.prime,
        emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne v.irreducible i.irreducible]
      · simp
      · exact fun h => hiv (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h.symm)
  · have hvS := hf v hv
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single v]
    · simp [emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime v.prime]
    · intro w hw hwv
      rw [emultiplicity_pow v.prime,
        emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne v.irreducible w.irreducible]
      · simp
      · exact fun h => hwv (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h.symm)
    · exact fun h => (h hvS).elim

name: Heights.exists_ideal_with_multiplicities_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_with_multiplicities_of_le
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    (f : HeightOneSpectrum R → ℕ) (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (hf : ∀ v, f v ≤ multiplicity v.asIdeal J) :
    ∃ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ v, multiplicity v.asIdeal I = f v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun v : HeightOneSpectrum R => v.asIdeal) := by
    intro v w h
    exact HeightOneSpectrum.ext h
  let S : Finset (HeightOneSpectrum R) :=
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).toFinset.preimage
      (fun v => v.asIdeal) hinj.injOn
  have hsupport : ∀ v, f v ≠ 0 → v ∈ S := by
    intro v hv
    change v ∈ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).toFinset.preimage
      (fun v => v.asIdeal) hinj.injOn
    rw [Finset.mem_preimage]
    simp only [Multiset.mem_toFinset]
    rw [← Multiset.count_ne_zero,
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.count_normalizedFactors_eq_multiplicity hJ]
    exact fun hm => hv (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hm ▸ hf v))
  let I : Ideal R := ∏ v ∈ S, v.asIdeal ^ f v
  have hI : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    change (∏ v ∈ S, v.asIdeal ^ f v) ≠ (0 : Ideal R)
    rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
    intro v hv
    exact pow_ne_zero _ v.ne_bot
  exact ⟨I, hI, fun v => by
    dsimp only [I]
    exact multiplicity_finset_product f S hsupport v⟩

name: Heights.nonempty_globalMinimalDiscriminantData
statement:
theorem nonempty_globalMinimalDiscriminantData
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic] :
    Nonempty (GlobalMinimalDiscriminantData K W)
proof:
:= by
  let C : WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange K :=
    Classical.choose (exists_integralModel_change W)
  have hC : WeierstrassCurve.IsIntegral (𝓞 K) (C • W) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_integralModel_change W)
  let E := C • W
  let d : 𝓞 K := (WeierstrassCurve.integralModel (𝓞 K) E).Δ
  let J : Ideal (𝓞 K) := Ideal.span {d}
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    have hΔ : E.Δ = 0 := by
      rw [← WeierstrassCurve.integralModel_Δ_eq (𝓞 K) E]
      change (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K) d = 0
      rw [hd, map_zero]
    rw [show E = C • W from rfl, WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_Δ] at hΔ
    exact W.isUnit_Δ.ne_zero (mul_eq_zero.mp hΔ |>.resolve_left
      (pow_ne_zero _ (Units.ne_zero _)))
  have hJ : J ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp hd
  have hbound : ∀ v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K),
      localMinimalDiscriminantExponent v W ≤ multiplicity v.asIdeal J := by
    intro v
    let m := localMinimalDiscriminantCertificate v W
    have hmax := m.maximal C (integralAt_of_isIntegral v hC)
    have hval : v.valuation K E.Δ =
        WithZero.exp (-(multiplicity v.asIdeal J : ℤ)) := by
      rw [← WeierstrassCurve.integralModel_Δ_eq (𝓞 K) E,
        IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_of_algebraMap,
        IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity v hd]
    rw [show C • W = E from rfl, hval, WithZero.exp_le_exp,
      neg_le_neg_iff, Int.ofNat_le] at hmax
    exact hmax
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hmult⟩ :=
    exists_ideal_with_multiplicities_of_le
      (fun v => localMinimalDiscriminantExponent v W) J hJ hbound
  exact ⟨{
    ideal := I
    ideal_ne_bot := hI
    realizes := fun v => hmult v ▸ localMinimalDiscriminantCertificate v W
  }⟩

name: Heights.nonempty_globalMinimalDiscriminantData_rat
statement:
theorem nonempty_globalMinimalDiscriminantData_rat
    (W : WeierstrassCurve ℚ) [W.IsElliptic] :
    Nonempty (GlobalMinimalDiscriminantData ℚ W)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_globalMinimalDiscriminantData W

name: Heights.IsLocalMinimalDiscriminantExponent.valuation_j_le_exp
proof:
:= by
  rw [← W.variableChange_j h.change]
  let E := h.change • W
  let ν := v.valuation K
  have hc₄ : ν E.c₄ ≤ 1 := h.integral.valuation_c₄_le_one
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.j, map_mul, map_pow, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
    map_inv₀, WeierstrassCurve.coe_Δ']
  change (ν E.Δ)⁻¹ * ν E.c₄ ^ 3 ≤ WithZero.exp (n : ℤ)
  rw [h.exponent, ← WithZero.exp_neg]
  simp only [neg_neg]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right bot_le (pow_le_one₀ bot_le hc₄)

name: Heights.Curve.pointEPlace_val_of_mem
statement:
theorem pointEPlace_val_of_mem (x : QbarPoint K) (τ : x.fieldOf →+* E) {f : K}
    (hf : f ∈ x.P.1) : (pointEPlace x τ).val f = some (τ (evalF x ⟨f, hf⟩))
proof:
:=
  EPlace.val_of_mem _ hf

name: Heights.Curve.natDegree_minpoly_padic_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_padic_le {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (τ : F →+* PadicAlgCl p) (a : F) :
    (minpoly ℚ_[p] (τ a)).natDegree ≤ Module.finrank ℚ F
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral ℚ a := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral a
  have hne : (minpoly ℚ a).map (algebraMap ℚ ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.map_ne_zero (minpoly.ne_zero hint)
  have hdvd : minpoly ℚ_[p] (τ a) ∣ (minpoly ℚ a).map (algebraMap ℚ ℚ_[p]) := by
    refine minpoly.dvd _ _ ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    have := congrArg τ.toRatAlgHom (minpoly.aeval ℚ a)
    rw [map_zero, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply] at this
    exact this
  calc (minpoly ℚ_[p] (τ a)).natDegree
      ≤ ((minpoly ℚ a).map (algebraMap ℚ ℚ_[p])).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd hne
    _ = (minpoly ℚ a).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map _
    _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ F := minpoly.natDegree_le a

name: Heights.Curve.countable_of_isCurveField
statement: theorem countable_of_isCurveField : Countable K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := IsCurveField.exists_finite (K := K)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮t⟯ K := finiteDimensional_adjoin ht
  haveI : Countable (Polynomial ℚ) := by
    rw [← Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0_iff]
    exact (Polynomial.cardinalMk_le_max (R := ℚ)).trans (by simp)
  haveI : Countable ℚ⟮t⟯ := by
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective fun pq : Polynomial ℚ × Polynomial ℚ =>
        (Polynomial.aeval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) pq.1 /
          Polynomial.aeval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) pq.2 : ℚ⟮t⟯) := by
      rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨r, s, rfl⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff ℚ y).mp hy
      refine ⟨(r, s), Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      change ((Polynomial.aeval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) r : ℚ⟮t⟯) : K) /
          ((Polynomial.aeval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) s : ℚ⟮t⟯) : K) = _
      have h1 : ∀ f : Polynomial ℚ,
          ((Polynomial.aeval (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) f : ℚ⟮t⟯) : K) =
            Polynomial.aeval t f := fun f => by
        have := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (IntermediateField.val ℚ⟮t⟯)
          (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ t) f
        exact this.symm
      rw [h1, h1]
    exact hsurj.countable
  exact Finsupp.Countable.of_moduleFinite (R := ℚ⟮t⟯) (M := K)

name: Heights.Curve.exists_surj_embeddings
statement:
theorem exists_surj_embeddings {E : Type*} [Field E] [CharZero E] [IsAlgClosed E]
    (x : QbarPoint K) {d : ℕ} (hd : x.deg ≤ d) :
    ∃ e : Fin d → (x.fieldOf →+* E), Function.Surjective e
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (x.fieldOf →+* E) ≤ d := by
    rw [NumberField.Embeddings.card]
    exact hd
  haveI : Nonempty (x.fieldOf →+* E) := inferInstance
  refine ⟨fun i => if h : (i : ℕ) < Fintype.card (x.fieldOf →+* E) then
      (Fintype.equivFin (x.fieldOf →+* E)).symm ⟨i, h⟩ else Classical.arbitrary _, fun τ => ?_⟩
  set j := Fintype.equivFin (x.fieldOf →+* E) τ
  refine ⟨⟨j, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hcard⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [j.2, dif_pos]
  exact (Fintype.equivFin (x.fieldOf →+* E)).symm_apply_apply τ

name: Heights.Curve.EPlace.val_ratCast
statement:
theorem EPlace.val_ratCast (y : EPlace K E) (hQ : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ y.O) (q : ℚ) :
    y.val (q : K) = some (q : E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EPlace.val_of_mem y (hQ q)]
  congr 1
  have hden : ((q.den : ℕ) : E) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr q.den_ne_zero
  have h1 : y.ψ ⟨(q : K), hQ q⟩ * (q.den : E) = (q.num : E) := by
    have h2 : (⟨(q : K), hQ q⟩ : y.O) * (q.den : y.O) = (q.num : y.O) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [MulMemClass.coe_mul, SubringClass.coe_natCast, SubringClass.coe_intCast]
      exact_mod_cast Rat.mul_den_eq_num q
    have := congrArg y.ψ h2
    rwa [map_mul, map_natCast, map_intCast] at this
  have hq : (q : E) = (q.num : E) / (q.den : E) := Rat.cast_def q
  rw [hq, eq_div_iff hden]
  exact h1

name: Heights.Curve.ratCast_mem_limitSubring
statement:
theorem ratCast_mem_limitSubring (hQ : ∀ n (q : ℚ), (q : K) ∈ (y n).O)
    (h : ∀ f, TendstoP1 (fun n => (y n).val f) (ξ f)) (q : ℚ) : (q : K) ∈ limitSubring h
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_limitSubring]
  have : ξ (q : K) = some (q : E) := (h (q : K)).unique
    ((tendstoP1_some_iff' (E := E)).mpr ⟨fun _ => (q : E),
      Eventually.of_forall fun n => EPlace.val_ratCast (y n) (hQ n) q, tendsto_const_nhds⟩)
  rw [this]
  exact Option.some_ne_none _

name: Heights.Curve.eventually_bounded_of_limitPlace
statement:
theorem eventually_bounded_of_limitPlace (hQ : ∀ n (q : ℚ), (q : K) ∈ (y n).O)
    (h : ∀ f, TendstoP1 (fun n => (y n).val f) (ξ f)) {φ : K} (hφ0 : φ ≠ 0) (hφ1 : φ ≠ 1)
    (hP : ∀ P, limitPlace hQ h = some P → φ ∈ P.1 ∧ φ⁻¹ ∈ P.1 ∧ (φ - 1)⁻¹ ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ α, (y n).val φ = some α ∧
      |Real.log ‖α‖| ≤ C ∧ |Real.log ‖α - 1‖| ≤ C ∧ α ≠ 0 ∧ α ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ g, (g = φ ∨ g = φ⁻¹ ∨ g = (φ - 1)⁻¹) → ξ g ≠ none := by
    intro g hg
    rw [← mem_limitSubring h]
    by_cases hT : limitSubring h = ⊤
    · rw [hT]
      exact ValuationSubring.mem_top g
    · have := hP ⟨limitSubring h, hT, ratCast_mem_limitSubring hQ h⟩ (by
        simp only [limitPlace, dif_neg hT])
      rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact this.1
      · exact this.2.1
      · exact this.2.2
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hmem φ (Or.inl rfl))
  have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hmem φ⁻¹ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) (limit_inv_of_eq_zero h hφ0 hβ)
  have hβ1 : β ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    have hm1 : ξ (-1) = some (-1) := limit_neg h (limit_one h)
    have h2 : ξ (φ - 1) = some 0 := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, limit_add h hβ hm1, add_neg_cancel]
    exact hmem (φ - 1)⁻¹ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
      (limit_inv_of_eq_zero h (sub_ne_zero.mpr hφ1) h2)
  exact eventually_abs_log_le h hβ hβ0 hβ1

name: Heights.Curve.exists_subseq_limit
statement:
theorem exists_subseq_limit {E : Type*} [NormedField E] {Good : E → Prop}
    (hcpt : ∀ a : ℕ → E, (∀ n, Good (a n)) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ((∃ b, Tendsto (a ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 b)) ∨ Tendsto (fun n => ‖a (φ n)‖) atTop atTop))
    {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (y : ℕ → Fin d → EPlace K E)
    (hgood : ∀ n i f α, (y n i).val f = some α → Good α) (D₀ : ℕ → ℕ) (hD₀ : StrictMono D₀) :
    ∃ D : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono D ∧ (∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ D = D₀ ∘ ψ) ∧
      ∃ ξ : Fin d → K → Option E, ∀ i f, TendstoP1 (fun n => (y (D n) i).val f) (ξ i f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := countable_of_isCurveField (K := K)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, ξ, hξ⟩ := exists_limit hcpt (fun n => y (D₀ n))
    (fun n i f α h => hgood _ _ _ _ h)
  exact ⟨D₀ ∘ ψ, hD₀.comp hψ, ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩, ξ, hξ⟩

name: Heights.Curve.tendstoP1_comp_subseq
statement:
theorem tendstoP1_comp_subseq {E : Type*} [NormedField E] {a : ℕ → Option E} {b : Option E}
    (h : TendstoP1 a b) {ψ : ℕ → ℕ} (hψ : StrictMono ψ) : TendstoP1 (a ∘ ψ) b
proof:
:=
  h.comp_of_tendsto hψ.tendsto_atTop

name: Heights.Curve.exists_subseq_bounded
statement:
theorem exists_subseq_bounded (V : Finset Nat.Primes) {d : ℕ} (x : ℕ → QbarPoint K)
    (hx : ∀ n, (x n).deg ≤ d) :
    ∃ D : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono D ∧ ∃ T : Finset (Place K), ∀ φ : K, φ ≠ 0 → φ ≠ 1 →
      (∀ P ∈ T, φ ∈ P.1 ∧ φ⁻¹ ∈ P.1 ∧ (φ - 1)⁻¹ ∈ P.1) →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ hφ : φ ∈ (x (D n)).P.1,
        evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ≠ 0 ∧ evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ≠ 1 ∧
        (∀ σ : (x (D n)).fieldOf →+* ℂ,
          |Real.log ‖σ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩)‖| ≤ C ∧
          |Real.log ‖σ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩) - 1‖| ≤ C) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ τ : (x (D n)).fieldOf →+* PadicAlgCl (p : ℕ),
          |Real.log ‖τ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩)‖| ≤ C ∧
          |Real.log ‖τ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφ⟩) - 1‖| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le (x 0).deg_pos (hx 0)
  haveI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  
  choose eC heC using fun n => exists_surj_embeddings (E := ℂ) (x n) (hx n)
  choose eP heP using fun (p : Nat.Primes) n =>
    exists_surj_embeddings (E := PadicAlgCl (p : ℕ)) (x n) (hx n)
  set yC : ℕ → Fin d → EPlace K ℂ := fun n i => pointEPlace (x n) (eC n i) with hyC
  set yP : ∀ p : Nat.Primes, ℕ → Fin d → EPlace K (PadicAlgCl (p : ℕ)) :=
    fun p n i => pointEPlace (x n) (eP p n i) with hyP
  have hQ : ∀ n (q : ℚ), (q : K) ∈ (x n).P.1 := fun n q => (x n).P.ratCast_mem q
  have hgoodP : ∀ (p : Nat.Primes) n i f α, (yP p n i).val f = some α →
      (minpoly ℚ_[(p : ℕ)] α).natDegree ≤ d := by
    intro p n i f α h
    obtain ⟨hf, rfl⟩ := (EPlace.val_eq_some_iff _).mp h
    exact (natDegree_minpoly_padic_le _ _).trans (hx n)
  
  have key : ∀ W : Finset Nat.Primes, ∃ D : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono D ∧
      (∃ ξ : Fin d → K → Option ℂ, ∀ i f, TendstoP1 (fun n => (yC (D n) i).val f) (ξ i f)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ W, ∃ ξ : Fin d → K → Option (PadicAlgCl (p : ℕ)),
        ∀ i f, TendstoP1 (fun n => (yP p (D n) i).val f) (ξ i f) := by
    intro W
    induction W using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      obtain ⟨D, hD, -, ξ, hξ⟩ := exists_subseq_limit (Good := fun _ : ℂ => True)
        (fun a _ => exists_tendsto_or_tendsto_norm_atTop a) yC (fun _ _ _ _ _ => trivial)
        id strictMono_id
      exact ⟨D, hD, ⟨ξ, hξ⟩, by simp⟩
    | insert p W hpW ih =>
      obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨ξC, hξC⟩, hW⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨D', hD', ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩, ξ, hξ⟩ :=
        exists_subseq_limit (Good := fun α : PadicAlgCl (p : ℕ) =>
          (minpoly ℚ_[(p : ℕ)] α).natDegree ≤ d)
          (fun a ha => PadicAlgCl.exists_tendsto_or_tendsto_norm_atTop d a ha) (yP p)
          (hgoodP p) D hD
      refine ⟨D ∘ ψ, hD', ⟨ξC, fun i f => tendstoP1_comp_subseq (hξC i f) hψ⟩, ?_⟩
      intro q hq
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hq with rfl | hqW
      · exact ⟨ξ, hξ⟩
      · obtain ⟨ξq, hξq⟩ := hW q hqW
        exact ⟨ξq, fun i f => tendstoP1_comp_subseq (hξq i f) hψ⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨ξC, hC⟩, hPV⟩ := key V
  choose ξP hξP using hPV
  have hQC : ∀ i n (q : ℚ), (q : K) ∈ (yC (D n) i).O := fun i n q => hQ (D n) q
  have hQP : ∀ p i n (q : ℚ), (q : K) ∈ (yP p (D n) i).O := fun p i n q => hQ (D n) q
  
  set T : Finset (Place K) :=
    (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i => (limitPlace (hQC i) (hC i)).toFinset) ∪
      V.attach.biUnion fun p => Finset.univ.biUnion fun i =>
        (limitPlace (hQP p.1 i) (hξP p.1 p.2 i)).toFinset with hT
  refine ⟨D, hD, T, fun φ hφ0 hφ1 hφT => ?_⟩
  have hbC : ∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ α, (yC (D n) i).val φ = some α ∧
      |Real.log ‖α‖| ≤ C ∧ |Real.log ‖α - 1‖| ≤ C ∧ α ≠ 0 ∧ α ≠ 1 := fun i =>
    eventually_bounded_of_limitPlace (hQC i) (hC i) hφ0 hφ1 fun P hP => hφT P (by
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact Or.inl ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, by simp [hP]⟩)
  have hbP : ∀ p : V, ∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ α, (yP p.1 (D n) i).val φ = some α ∧
      |Real.log ‖α‖| ≤ C ∧ |Real.log ‖α - 1‖| ≤ C ∧ α ≠ 0 ∧ α ≠ 1 := fun p i =>
    eventually_bounded_of_limitPlace (hQP p.1 i) (hξP p.1 p.2 i) hφ0 hφ1 fun P hP => hφT P (by
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      right
      rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨p, Finset.mem_attach _ _, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, by simp [hP]⟩⟩)
  choose CC hCC using hbC
  choose CP hCP using hbP
  set C : ℝ := ∑ i, |CC i| + ∑ p ∈ V.attach, ∑ i, |CP p i| with hCdef
  have hCC_le : ∀ i, CC i ≤ C := fun i => by
    have h1 : |CC i| ≤ ∑ i, |CC i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |CC i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ V.attach, ∑ i, |CP p i| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _
    linarith [le_abs_self (CC i)]
  have hCP_le : ∀ p i, CP p i ≤ C := fun p i => by
    have h1 : |CP p i| ≤ ∑ i, |CP p i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |CP p i|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h2 : ∑ i, |CP p i| ≤ ∑ p ∈ V.attach, ∑ i, |CP p i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun p => ∑ i, |CP p i|)
        (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_attach _ p)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, |CC i| := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _
    linarith [le_abs_self (CP p i)]
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  have hevC := Filter.eventually_all.mpr hCC
  have hevP : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ p ∈ V.attach, ∀ i, ∃ α, (yP p.1 (D n) i).val φ = some α ∧
      |Real.log ‖α‖| ≤ CP p i ∧ |Real.log ‖α - 1‖| ≤ CP p i ∧ α ≠ 0 ∧ α ≠ 1 :=
    (Filter.eventually_all_finset _).mpr fun p _ => Filter.eventually_all.mpr (hCP p)
  filter_upwards [hevC, hevP] with n hnC hnP
  obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀, -, -, hα₀0, hα₀1⟩ := hnC ⟨0, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨hφmem, hα₀eq⟩ := (EPlace.val_eq_some_iff _).mp hα₀
  have hv0 : evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩ ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hα₀0 (by
    rw [← hα₀eq]
    change eC (D n) ⟨0, hd⟩ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩) = 0
    rw [h0, map_zero])
  have hv1 : evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩ ≠ 1 := fun h0 => hα₀1 (by
    rw [← hα₀eq]
    change eC (D n) ⟨0, hd⟩ (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩) = 1
    rw [h0, map_one])
  refine ⟨hφmem, hv0, hv1, fun σ => ?_, fun p hp τ => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := heC (D n) σ
    obtain ⟨α, hα, h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hnC i
    rw [show (yC (D n) i).val φ = some (eC (D n) i (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩)) from
      pointEPlace_val_of_mem _ _ hφmem] at hα
    cases hα
    exact ⟨h1.trans (hCC_le i), h2.trans (hCC_le i)⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := heP p (D n) τ
    obtain ⟨α, hα, h1, h2, -, -⟩ := hnP ⟨p, hp⟩ (Finset.mem_attach _ _) i
    rw [show (yP p (D n) i).val φ = some (eP p (D n) i (evalF (x (D n)) ⟨φ, hφmem⟩)) from
      pointEPlace_val_of_mem _ _ hφmem] at hα
    cases hα
    exact ⟨h1.trans (hCP_le ⟨p, hp⟩ i), h2.trans (hCP_le ⟨p, hp⟩ i)⟩

name: Heights.Curve.minOrd_triple_one
statement:
theorem minOrd_triple_one (g f : K) (P : Place K) :
    minOrd P ![1, g, f] = min (minOrd P ![1, g]) (minOrd P ![1, f])
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∃ i, (![1, g, f] : Fin 3 → K) i ≠ 0 := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hg : ![(1 : K), g, f] ∘ ![0, 1] = ![1, g] := by
    funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hf : ![(1 : K), g, f] ∘ ![0, 2] = ![1, f] := by
    funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_min ?_ ?_
    · have := minOrd_le_minOrd_comp hs ![0, 1] (by rw [hg]; exact exists_ne_zero_pair_one g) P
      rwa [hg] at this
    · have := minOrd_le_minOrd_comp hs ![0, 2] (by rw [hf]; exact exists_ne_zero_pair_one f) P
      rwa [hf] at this
  · rw [minOrd_eq hs]
    have hne := normIdx_ne_zero (P := P) hs
    generalize normIdx P ![1, g, f] hs = i at hne ⊢
    have hg1 := minOrd_le (P := P) (exists_ne_zero_pair_one g) (j := 0) (by simp)
    have hf1 := minOrd_le (P := P) (exists_ne_zero_pair_one f) (j := 0) (by simp)
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Place.ord_one] at hg1 ⊢
      exact min_le_of_left_le (by simpa using hg1)
    · have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by simpa using hne
      have := minOrd_le (P := P) (exists_ne_zero_pair_one g) (j := 1) (by simpa using hg0)
      simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this ⊢
      exact min_le_of_left_le this
    · have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by simpa using hne
      have := minOrd_le (P := P) (exists_ne_zero_pair_one f) (j := 1) (by simpa using hf0)
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero] at this
      simp only [Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val]
      exact min_le_of_right_le this

name: Heights.Curve.logCondOf_le_divHeight
statement:
theorem logCondOf_le_divHeight (E : Divisor K) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (G : Finset K)
    (hG : ∀ P : Place K, E P = 0 → ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ C, ∀ x : QbarPoint K, (∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ x.P.1) → logCondOf G x ≤ divHeight E x + C
proof:
:= by
  set f := (polarRep E).1
  set g := (polarRep E).2
  have hrep : E = polarDivisor f - polarDivisor g := polarRep_spec E
  have hEP : ∀ P, E P = polarDivisor f P - polarDivisor g P := fun P => by
    rw [hrep]; rfl
  have hs : ∃ i, (![1, g, f] : Fin 3 → K) i ≠ 0 := ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hcomp : ![(1 : K), g, f] ∘ ![0, 1] = ![1, g] := by
    funext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hmin : ∀ P : Place K, minOrd P ![1, g, f] = -polarDivisor f P := fun P => by
    rw [minOrd_triple_one, minOrd_pair_one, minOrd_pair_one]
    have := hEP P
    have := hE P
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := logCondOf_le_tupleHeight_sub hs ![0, 1]
    (by rw [hcomp]; exact exists_ne_zero_pair_one g) G fun P hP => by
      rw [hcomp, hmin, minOrd_pair_one] at hP
      exact hG P (by rw [hEP]; omega)
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := divHeight_approx E hs (exists_ne_zero_pair_one g) one_ne_zero fun P => by
    rw [hmin, minOrd_pair_one, Place.ord_one, hEP]
    ring
  refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hC₁ x hx
  have h2 := hC₂ x
  rw [hcomp] at h1
  rw [abs_le] at h2
  linarith [h2.1]

name: Heights.Curve.logCondOf_eq_cond
statement:
theorem logCondOf_eq_cond (G : Finset K) (x : QbarPoint K) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ x.P.1) :
    logCondOf G x =
      Heights.Different.cond (G.attach.image fun g => evalF x ⟨g.1, hG g.1 g.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logCondOf Heights.Different.cond
  rw [dif_pos hG]
  congr 1
  refine finsum_congr fun w => ?_
  have hiff : w ∈ meetsAt x G hG ↔
      w ∈ Heights.Different.meets (G.attach.image fun g => evalF x ⟨g.1, hG g.1 g.2⟩) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, hg, hlt⟩
      exact ⟨_, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩, hlt⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, hlt⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      exact ⟨g, hg, hlt⟩
  by_cases hw : w ∈ meetsAt x G hG
  · rw [if_pos hw, if_pos (hiff.mp hw)]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hw, if_neg (fun h => hw (hiff.mpr h))]

name: Heights.Curve.FinitePlace.exists_eq_zpow
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.exists_eq_zpow (w : FinitePlace F) {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, w a = (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  set v := w.maximalIdeal
  have h1 : w a = HeightOneSpectrum.adicAbv F v a := by
    rw [← FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq, FinitePlace.norm_embedding]
  have hva : v.valuation F a ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).mpr ha
  refine ⟨(WithZero.unzero hva).toAdd, ?_⟩
  rw [h1, HeightOneSpectrum.adicAbv_def, WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal_neg_apply _ hva]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Heights.Curve.FinitePlace.mul_absNorm_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.mul_absNorm_le_of_lt (w : FinitePlace F) {a b : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hlt : w b < w a) : (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : ℝ) * w b ≤ w a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ka, hka⟩ := FinitePlace.exists_eq_zpow w ha
  obtain ⟨kb, hkb⟩ := FinitePlace.exists_eq_zpow w hb
  have hN : (1 : ℝ) < (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.one_lt_absNorm w.maximalIdeal
  set N : ℝ := (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : ℝ)
  rw [hka, hkb] at hlt ⊢
  have hk : kb < ka := (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ hN).mp hlt
  calc N * N ^ kb = N ^ (kb + 1) := by rw [zpow_add_one₀ (by linarith), mul_comm]
    _ ≤ N ^ ka := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hN.le (by omega)

name: Heights.Curve.FinitePlace.absNorm_le_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.absNorm_le_of_one_lt (w : FinitePlace F) {a : F} (ha : 1 < w a) :
    (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal : ℝ) ≤ w a
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at ha
    linarith
  have := FinitePlace.mul_absNorm_le_of_lt w ha0 one_ne_zero (by rwa [map_one])
  rwa [map_one, mul_one] at this

name: Heights.Curve.minOrd_le_minOrd_comp
statement:
theorem minOrd_le_minOrd_comp {s : ι → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (e : κ → ι)
    (hse : ∃ j, (s ∘ e) j ≠ 0) (P : Place K) : minOrd P s ≤ minOrd P (s ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [minOrd_eq hse]
  exact minOrd_le hs (normIdx_ne_zero hse)

name: Heights.Curve.finsum_posLog_le
statement:
theorem finsum_posLog_le (F : IntermediateField ℚ Qbar) [FiniteDimensional ℚ F] (q : ℚ) :
    ∑ᶠ v : FinitePlace F, Real.posLog (v (q : F)) ≤
      (Module.finrank ℚ F : ℝ) * Height.logHeight₁ q
proof:
:= by
  have := finrank_mul_logHeight_one_comp_ringHom_eq_sum (F.val : F →+* Qbar) (q : F)
  have h2 : (F.val : F →+* Qbar) (q : F) = algebraMap ℚ Qbar q := by simp
  rw [h2, logHeight_one_ratCast] at this
  rw [this]
  have : 0 ≤ ∑ w : InfinitePlace F, (w.mult : ℝ) * Real.posLog (w (q : F)) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun w _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) Real.posLog_nonneg
  linarith

name: Heights.Curve.hasFiniteSupport_meetsAt
statement:
theorem hasFiniteSupport_meetsAt (x : QbarPoint K) (G : Finset K) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ x.P.1) :
    (fun w : FinitePlace x.fieldOf => if w ∈ meetsAt x G hG then
      Real.log (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) else 0).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:= by
  refine (Set.Finite.biUnion (s := {g : G | x.eval g.1 (hG g.1 g.2) ≠ 0}) (Set.toFinite _)
    fun g hg => FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport
      (x := (⟨x.eval g.1 (hG g.1 g.2), x.eval_mem_fieldOf _⟩ : x.fieldOf)) (by
        intro h0
        apply hg
        exact congrArg Subtype.val h0)).subset fun w hw => ?_
  simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, Classical.not_imp] at hw
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hgG, hg1⟩, -⟩ := hw
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.mem_mulSupport, exists_prop]
  refine ⟨⟨g, hgG⟩, fun h0 => ?_, hg1.ne'⟩
  have : (⟨x.eval g (hG g hgG), x.eval_mem_fieldOf _⟩ : x.fieldOf) = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
  rw [this, map_zero] at hg1
  linarith

name: Heights.Curve.logCondOf_le_tupleHeight_sub
statement:
theorem logCondOf_le_tupleHeight_sub {s : ι → K} (hs : ∃ i, s i ≠ 0) (e : κ → ι)
    (hse : ∃ j, (s ∘ e) j ≠ 0) (G : Finset K)
    (hGreg : ∀ P : Place K, minOrd P s = minOrd P (s ∘ e) → ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ P.1) :
    ∃ C, ∀ x : QbarPoint K, (∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ x.P.1) →
      logCondOf G x ≤ tupleHeight s x - tupleHeight (s ∘ e) x + C
proof:
:= by
  
  have hint : ∀ (g : G) (j : κ), ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ Q : ℕ → MvPolynomial ι ℚ, s (e j) ≠ 0 →
      (g : K) ^ n + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        MvPolynomial.aeval (fun l => s l / s (e j)) (Q k) * (g : K) ^ k = 0 := by
    intro g j
    by_cases hj : s (e j) = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun _ => 0, fun h => absurd hj h⟩
    obtain ⟨n, Q, hQ⟩ := exists_integral_eq (fun l => s l / s (e j)) (g : K) fun P hP => by
      refine hGreg P (le_antisymm (minOrd_le_minOrd_comp hs e hse P) ?_) g g.2
      have h1 : minOrd P (s ∘ e) ≤ P.ord (s (e j)) := minOrd_le hse hj
      have h2 : P.ord (s (e j)) ≤ minOrd P s := by
        rw [minOrd_eq hs]
        have := P.ord_nonneg_of_mem (hP (normIdx P s hs))
        rw [P.ord_div (normIdx_ne_zero hs) hj] at this
        linarith
      linarith
    exact ⟨n, Q, fun _ => hQ⟩
  choose n Q hQ using hint
  
  set U : Finset (Σ p : G × κ, Σ _ : ℕ, ι →₀ ℕ) :=
    Finset.univ.sigma fun p => (Finset.range (n p.1 p.2)).sigma fun k => (Q p.1 p.2 k).support
    with hU
  set q : (Σ p : G × κ, Σ _ : ℕ, ι →₀ ℕ) → ℚ := fun τ => (Q τ.1.1 τ.1.2 τ.2.1).coeff τ.2.2
    with hq
  have hloc : ∀ {F : Type} [Field F] [CharZero F] (W : AbsoluteValue F ℝ) (g : G) (j : κ),
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n g j), ∑ m ∈ (Q g j k).support,
          Real.posLog (W (((Q g j k).coeff m : ℚ) : F)) ≤
        ∑ τ ∈ U, Real.posLog (W (q τ : F)) := by
    intro F _ _ W g j
    have hsub : ((Finset.range (n g j)).sigma fun k => (Q g j k).support).map
        ⟨fun τ => (⟨(g, j), τ⟩ : Σ p : G × κ, Σ _ : ℕ, ι →₀ ℕ), fun a b h => by
          simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and] at h; exact h⟩ ⊆ U := by
      intro τ hτ
      simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range,
        Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk] at hτ
      obtain ⟨⟨k, m⟩, ⟨hk, hm⟩, rfl⟩ := hτ
      simp [hU, hk, hm]
    calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n g j), ∑ m ∈ (Q g j k).support,
          Real.posLog (W (((Q g j k).coeff m : ℚ) : F))
        = ∑ τ ∈ ((Finset.range (n g j)).sigma fun k => (Q g j k).support).map
            ⟨fun τ => (⟨(g, j), τ⟩ : Σ p : G × κ, Σ _ : ℕ, ι →₀ ℕ), fun a b h => by
