    have heq := hw (τ : ℂ) τ.im_pos
    simp only [g, Function.comp_apply, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply] at heq
    rw [heq] at hτ
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hτ)
  · have himage : IsOpen (g '' upperHalfPlaneSet) :=
      hopen upperHalfPlaneSet subset_rfl isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet
    have heq : g '' upperHalfPlaneSet = Set.range modularJ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex w, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨τ, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨(τ : ℂ), τ.im_pos, by simp [g]⟩
    exact heq ▸ himage

name: Heights.isClosed_range_modularJ
statement: theorem isClosed_range_modularJ : IsClosed (Set.range modularJ)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSeqClosed.isClosed
  intro u z hu huz
  choose τ hτ using hu
  choose γ hγ using fun n => ModularGroup.exists_smul_mem_fd (τ n)
  let σ : ℕ → ℍ := fun n => γ n • τ n
  have hσfd (n : ℕ) : σ n ∈ ModularGroup.fd := hγ n
  have hσJ (n : ℕ) : modularJ (σ n) = u n := by
    change modularJ (γ n • τ n) = u n
    rw [modularJ_smul, hτ n]
  let R : ℝ := ‖z‖ + 1
  have hu_norm : Tendsto (fun n => ‖u n‖) atTop (𝓝 ‖z‖) :=
    continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp huz
  have hu_bound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ‖u n‖ < R :=
    hu_norm.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by simp [R]))
  rw [eventually_atTop] at hu_bound
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu_bound
  have hcusp : ∀ᶠ ξ in atImInfty, R < ‖modularJ ξ‖ :=
    modularJ_norm_tendsto_atImInfty.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop R)
  rw [atImInfty, eventually_comap, eventually_atTop] at hcusp
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hcusp
  have hshift (n : ℕ) : σ (n + N) ∈ ModularGroup.truncatedFundamentalDomain y := by
    refine ⟨hσfd _, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have him : y ≤ (σ (n + N)).im := le_of_not_ge hnot
    have hlarge : R < ‖modularJ (σ (n + N))‖ := hy _ him _ rfl
    rw [hσJ] at hlarge
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt (hN (n + N) (Nat.le_add_left N n)))) hlarge
  obtain ⟨ξ, _hξ, φ, hφmono, hφlim⟩ :=
    (ModularGroup.isCompact_truncatedFundamentalDomain y).isSeqCompact hshift
  refine ⟨ξ, ?_⟩
  have hlimJ : Tendsto (fun n => modularJ (σ (φ n + N))) atTop (𝓝 (modularJ ξ)) :=
    modularJ_mdifferentiable.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hφlim
  have hindex : Tendsto (fun n => φ n + N) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N).comp hφmono.tendsto_atTop
  have hlimu : Tendsto (fun n => u (φ n + N)) atTop (𝓝 z) := huz.comp hindex
  have heq : (fun n => modularJ (σ (φ n + N))) = (fun n => u (φ n + N)) := by
    funext n
    exact hσJ _
  rw [heq] at hlimJ
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlimJ hlimu

name: Heights.modularJ_surjective
statement: theorem modularJ_surjective : Function.Surjective modularJ
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range modularJ = Set.univ :=
    IsClopen.eq_univ ⟨isClosed_range_modularJ, isOpen_range_modularJ⟩
      ⟨modularJ UpperHalfPlane.I, ⟨UpperHalfPlane.I, rfl⟩⟩
  exact Set.range_eq_univ.mp hrange

name: Heights.log_max_modularJ_div_im_tendsto
statement:
private theorem log_max_modularJ_div_im_tendsto : Tendsto
    (fun τ : ℍ => Real.log (max ‖modularJ τ‖ (Real.exp 1)) / τ.im)
    atImInfty (𝓝 (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have hslog : Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℍ => Real.log
        (‖modularJ τ‖ * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im)))
      atImInfty (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using scaledModularJ_tendsto_atImInfty.log one_ne_zero
  have hsmall : Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℍ =>
        Real.log (‖modularJ τ‖ * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im)) / τ.im)
      atImInfty (𝓝 0) := hslog.div_atTop im_tendsto_atImInfty
  have hform := (tendsto_const_nhds.add hsmall : Tendsto
    (fun τ : ℍ => 2 * Real.pi +
      Real.log (‖modularJ τ‖ * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im)) / τ.im)
    atImInfty (𝓝 (2 * Real.pi + 0)))
  have hs_half : ∀ᶠ τ in atImInfty,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ‖modularJ τ‖ * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im) :=
    scaledModularJ_tendsto_atImInfty.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have he_large : ∀ᶠ τ in atImInfty,
      2 * Real.exp 1 < Real.exp (2 * Real.pi * τ.im) :=
    exp_two_pi_im_tendsto_atImInfty.eventually
      (eventually_gt_atTop (2 * Real.exp 1))
  rw [← add_zero (2 * Real.pi)]
  apply hform.congr'
  filter_upwards [hs_half, he_large] with τ hs he
  have hy : τ.im ≠ 0 := τ.im_ne_zero
  have hexp_neg : Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  have hj_ne : ‖modularJ τ‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj
    rw [hj, zero_mul] at hs
    linarith
  have hj_eq : ‖modularJ τ‖ =
      (‖modularJ τ‖ * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * τ.im)) *
        Real.exp (2 * Real.pi * τ.im) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
    simp
  have hj_gt : Real.exp 1 < ‖modularJ τ‖ := by
    rw [hj_eq]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
  rw [max_eq_left hj_gt.le]
  rw [Real.log_mul hj_ne hexp_neg, Real.log_exp]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Heights.modularImLogLogJComparisonCore_continuous
statement:
private theorem modularImLogLogJComparisonCore_continuous :
    Continuous modularImLogLogJComparisonCore
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : Continuous modularJ := by
    exact (ModularFormClass.continuous ModularForm.E₄).pow 3 |>.div
      (by simpa only [CuspForm.coe_discriminant] using
        ModularFormClass.continuous CuspForm.discriminant)
      (fun τ => ModularForm.discriminant_ne_zero τ)
  have hmax : Continuous (fun τ : ℍ => max ‖modularJ τ‖ (Real.exp 1)) :=
    hJ.norm.max continuous_const
  have hlog_pos : ∀ τ : ℍ,
      0 < Real.log (max ‖modularJ τ‖ (Real.exp 1)) := by
    intro τ
    exact Real.log_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr zero_lt_one) (le_max_right _ _))
  exact continuous_im.log (fun τ => τ.im_ne_zero) |>.sub
    ((hmax.log fun τ => ne_of_gt
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) (le_max_right _ _))).log
      fun τ => (hlog_pos τ).ne')

name: Heights.modularImLogLogJComparisonCore_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  have hneglog : Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℍ => -Real.log
        (Real.log (max ‖modularJ τ‖ (Real.exp 1)) / τ.im))
      atImInfty (𝓝 (-Real.log (2 * Real.pi))) := by
    exact (log_max_modularJ_div_im_tendsto.log
      (ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos Real.pi_pos))).neg
  apply hneglog.congr'
  filter_upwards with τ
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr zero_lt_one) (le_max_right _ _)))) τ.im_ne_zero]
  simp only [modularImLogLogJComparisonCore]
  ring

name: Heights.modularIm_logLogJ_fd_comparison
statement:
theorem modularIm_logLogJ_fd_comparison :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ τ : ℍ, τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd →
      |Real.log τ.im -
        Real.log (Real.log (max ‖modularJ τ‖ (Real.exp 1)))| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hO : modularImLogLogJComparisonCore =O[atImInfty]
      (fun z : ℍ => z.im ^ (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using modularImLogLogJComparisonCore_tendsto.isBigO_one ℝ
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ModularGroup.exists_bound_fundamental_domain_of_isBigO
    modularImLogLogJComparisonCore_continuous hO
  refine ⟨max F 0, le_max_right _ _, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
  change |modularImLogLogJComparisonCore τ| ≤ max F 0
  calc
    |modularImLogLogJComparisonCore τ| = ‖modularImLogLogJComparisonCore τ‖ :=
      (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ F := by simpa using hF τ hτ
    _ ≤ max F 0 := le_max_left _ _

name: Heights.latticeWeierstrassCurve_c6
statement:
theorem latticeWeierstrassCurve_c6 (τ : ℍ) :
    (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).c₆ =
      216 * (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).g₃
proof:
:= by
  simp [WeierstrassCurve.c₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, latticeWeierstrassCurve]
  ring

name: Heights.exists_scale_lattice_eq_of_modularJ_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_scale_lattice_eq_of_modularJ_eq (τ τ' : ℍ)
    (hj : modularJ τ = modularJ τ') :
    ∃ (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0),
      (periodPairScale a ha (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ)).lattice =
        (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ').lattice
proof:
:= by
  have hcurves : (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).j =
      (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ').j := by
    rw [latticeWeierstrassCurve_j, latticeWeierstrassCurve_j, hj]
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := WeierstrassCurve.exists_variableChange_of_j_eq
    (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ) (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ') hcurves
  let a : ℂ := C.u
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero C.u
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  apply periodPair_lattice_eq_of_g₂_eq_g₃_eq
  · have hc := congrArg WeierstrassCurve.c₄ hC
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_c₄, latticeWeierstrassCurve_c4,
      latticeWeierstrassCurve_c4] at hc
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at hc
    rw [periodPairScale_g₂]
    dsimp [a]
    linear_combination hc / 12
  · have hc := congrArg WeierstrassCurve.c₆ hC
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_c₆, latticeWeierstrassCurve_c6,
      latticeWeierstrassCurve_c6] at hc
    rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at hc
    rw [periodPairScale_g₃]
    dsimp [a]
    linear_combination hc / 216

name: Heights.int_linear_combination_injective
proof:
:= by
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  norm_num at him
  have hm : m = m' := him.resolve_right τ.im_ne_zero
  subst m'
  norm_num at h
  exact ⟨rfl, h⟩

name: Heights.exists_smul_eq_of_modularJ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_of_modularJ_eq (τ τ' : ℍ)
    (hj : modularJ τ = modularJ τ') :
    ∃ γ : SL(2, ℤ), γ • τ' = τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hlat⟩ := exists_scale_lattice_eq_of_modularJ_eq τ τ' hj
  let L := periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ
  let L' := periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ'
  let S := periodPairScale a ha L
  have haτmem : a * (τ : ℂ) ∈ L'.lattice := by
    rw [← hlat]
    exact S.ω₁_mem_lattice
  have hamem : a ∈ L'.lattice := by
    rw [← hlat]
    simpa [L, S] using S.ω₂_mem_lattice
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA⟩ := PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mp haτmem
  obtain ⟨C, D, hC⟩ := PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mp hamem
  have hA' : (A : ℂ) * τ' + B = a * τ := by simpa [L'] using hA
  have hC' : (C : ℂ) * τ' + D = a := by simpa [L'] using hC
  have hτ'mem : (τ' : ℂ) ∈ S.lattice := by
    rw [hlat]
    exact L'.ω₁_mem_lattice
  have h1mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ S.lattice := by
    rw [hlat]
    exact L'.ω₂_mem_lattice
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP⟩ := PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mp hτ'mem
  obtain ⟨R, T, hR⟩ := PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mp h1mem
  have hP' : (P : ℂ) * (a * τ) + Q * a = τ' := by
    simpa [S, L] using hP
  have hR' : (R : ℂ) * (a * τ) + T * a = 1 := by
    simpa [S, L] using hR
  have hPA : P * A + Q * C = 1 ∧ P * B + Q * D = 0 := by
    apply int_linear_combination_injective τ'
    calc
      ((P * A + Q * C : ℤ) : ℂ) * τ' + (P * B + Q * D : ℤ) =
          (P : ℂ) * ((A : ℂ) * τ' + B) +
            (Q : ℂ) * ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = (P : ℂ) * (a * τ) + Q * a := by rw [hA', hC']
      _ = (1 : ℤ) * (τ' : ℂ) + (0 : ℤ) := by simpa using hP'
  have hRA : R * A + T * C = 0 ∧ R * B + T * D = 1 := by
    apply int_linear_combination_injective τ'
    calc
      ((R * A + T * C : ℤ) : ℂ) * τ' + (R * B + T * D : ℤ) =
          (R : ℂ) * ((A : ℂ) * τ' + B) +
            (T : ℂ) * ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = (R : ℂ) * (a * τ) + T * a := by rw [hA', hC']
      _ = (0 : ℤ) * (τ' : ℂ) + (1 : ℤ) := by simpa using hR'
  have hdetprod : (P * T - Q * R) * (A * D - B * C) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_sub, sub_mul]
    nlinarith [hPA.1, hPA.2, hRA.1, hRA.2]
  have hdet_cases : A * D - B * C = 1 ∨ A * D - B * C = -1 := by
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one' hdetprod with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h.2
    · exact Or.inr h.2
  have hτeq : (τ : ℂ) =
      ((A : ℂ) * τ' + B) / ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) := by
    rw [hC']
    field_simp [ha]
    simpa [mul_comm] using hA'.symm
  have hformula :
      (((A : ℂ) * τ' + B) / ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D)).im =
        ((A * D - B * C : ℤ) : ℝ) * τ'.im /
          Complex.normSq ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) := by
    rw [Complex.div_im]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hdet : A * D - B * C = 1 := by
    rcases hdet_cases with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      rw [h] at hformula
      norm_num at hformula
      rw [← hτeq] at hformula
      have hnorm : 0 < Complex.normSq ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) := by
        rw [hC']
        exact Complex.normSq_pos.mpr ha
      have hneg : -τ'.im / Complex.normSq ((C : ℂ) * τ' + D) < 0 :=
        div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos τ'.im_pos) hnorm
      have htneg : τ.im < 0 := by
        rw [← UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, hformula]
        exact hneg
      exact (not_lt_of_ge τ.im_pos.le) htneg
  let γ : SL(2, ℤ) := ⟨!![A, B; C, D], by
    simp [Matrix.det_fin_two, hdet]⟩
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.ext_iff, UpperHalfPlane.coe_specialLinearGroup_apply]
  change num γ τ' / denom γ τ' = (τ : ℂ)
  simp only [γ, num, denom, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL]
  exact hτeq.symm

name: Heights.silvermanModularDiscriminant_smul
statement:
theorem silvermanModularDiscriminant_smul (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    silvermanModularDiscriminant (γ • τ) =
      denom γ τ ^ (12 : ℕ) * silvermanModularDiscriminant τ
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ModularForm.discriminant (γ • τ) =
      denom γ τ ^ (12 : ℤ) * ModularForm.discriminant τ := by
    letI : SlashInvariantFormClass (CuspForm 𝒮ℒ 12) Γ(1) 12 :=
      Gamma_one_coe_eq_SL ▸ inferInstance
    exact SlashInvariantForm.slash_action_eqn_SL'' CuspForm.discriminant
      (mem_Gamma_one γ) τ
  rw [silvermanModularDiscriminant, silvermanModularDiscriminant, hD]
  ac_rfl

name: Heights.silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_smul
statement:
theorem silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_smul
    (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant (γ • τ)‖ * (γ • τ).im ^ 6 =
      ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant τ‖ * τ.im ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [silvermanModularDiscriminant_smul, norm_mul, norm_pow,
    ModularGroup.im_smul_eq_div_normSq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hn : ‖denom γ τ‖ ≠ 0 :=
    norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (denom_ne_zero γ τ)
  field_simp

name: Heights.silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_eq_of_modularJ_eq
statement:
theorem silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_eq_of_modularJ_eq
    (τ τ' : ℍ) (hj : modularJ τ = modularJ τ') :
    ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant τ‖ * τ.im ^ 6 =
      ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant τ'‖ * τ'.im ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_modularJ_eq τ τ' hj
  exact silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_smul γ τ'

name: Heights.periodPairScale_ω₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodPairScale_ω₁ (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (L : PeriodPair) :
    (periodPairScale a ha L).ω₁ = a * L.ω₁
proof: := rfl

name: Heights.periodPairScale_ω₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodPairScale_ω₂ (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (L : PeriodPair) :
    (periodPairScale a ha L).ω₂ = a * L.ω₂
proof: := rfl

name: Heights.periodPairScaleLatticeEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodPairScaleLatticeEquiv_coe (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (L : PeriodPair) (x : L.lattice) :
    ((periodPairScaleLatticeEquiv a ha L x : (periodPairScale a ha L).lattice) : ℂ) =
      a * (x : ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: Heights.periodPairScale_G
statement:
theorem periodPairScale_G (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (L : PeriodPair) (k : ℕ) :
    (periodPairScale a ha L).G k = a⁻¹ ^ k * L.G k
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodPair.G, PeriodPair.G, ← tsum_mul_left]
  rw [← (periodPairScaleLatticeEquiv a ha L).toEquiv.tsum_eq]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro l
  change ((a * (l : ℂ)) ^ k)⁻¹ = _
  rw [mul_pow, mul_inv, inv_pow]

name: Heights.periodPairScale_g₂
statement:
theorem periodPairScale_g₂ (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (L : PeriodPair) :
    (periodPairScale a ha L).g₂ = a⁻¹ ^ 4 * L.g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodPair.g₂, periodPairScale_G, PeriodPair.g₂]
  ring

name: Heights.periodPairScale_g₃
statement:
theorem periodPairScale_g₃ (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (L : PeriodPair) :
    (periodPairScale a ha L).g₃ = a⁻¹ ^ 6 * L.g₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodPair.g₃, periodPairScale_G, PeriodPair.g₃]
  ring

name: Heights.analyticAt_reciprocalX
statement:
private theorem analyticAt_reciprocalX (L : PeriodPair) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (reciprocalX L) 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AnalyticAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  norm_num [reciprocalX]

name: Heights.analyticAt_reciprocalY
statement:
private theorem analyticAt_reciprocalY (L : PeriodPair) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (reciprocalY L) 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AnalyticAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  norm_num [reciprocalY]

name: Heights.reciprocalX_zero
statement: @[simp] private theorem reciprocalX_zero (L : PeriodPair) : reciprocalX L 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [reciprocalX]

name: Heights.reciprocalY_zero
statement: @[simp] private theorem reciprocalY_zero (L : PeriodPair) : reciprocalY L 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [reciprocalY]

name: Heights.reciprocalX_eq_inv
statement:
private theorem reciprocalX_eq_inv (L : PeriodPair) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    reciprocalX L z = (L.weierstrassP z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalX, ← L.weierstrassPExcept_add (0 : L.lattice)]
  simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Heights.reciprocalY_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalY, ← L.weierstrassPExcept_add (0 : L.lattice),
    ← L.derivWeierstrassPExcept_sub (0 : L.lattice)]
  simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, sub_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Heights.eventually_reciprocal_nonzero
statement:
private theorem eventually_reciprocal_nonzero (L : PeriodPair) :
    ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, L.weierstrassP z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (tendsto_sq_mul_weierstrassP_zero L)
    (eventually_ne_nhds one_ne_zero)
  filter_upwards [h, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hzP hz0
  exact fun hP ↦ hzP (by simp [hP])

name: Heights.eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalX
proof:
:= by
  have hpunct : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,
      HasDerivAt (reciprocalX L) (2 * reciprocalY L z) z := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_reciprocal_nonzero L,
      mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds 0),
      self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hP hzL hz0
    have hz : z ≠ 0 := by simpa using hz0
    have hnot : z ∉ L.lattice := by simp_all
    have hderiv : HasDerivAt L.weierstrassP (L.derivWeierstrassP z) z := by
      rw [← L.deriv_weierstrassP]
      exact (L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hnot).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have heq : reciprocalX L =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w ↦ (L.weierstrassP w)⁻¹ := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact reciprocalX_eq_inv L w hw
    have hi := (hderiv.inv hP).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
    have hval : -L.derivWeierstrassP z / L.weierstrassP z ^ 2 =
        2 * reciprocalY L z := by
      rw [reciprocalY_eq L z hz]
      field_simp
    rw [← hval]
    exact hi
  have hrhs : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦ 2 * reciprocalY L z) 0 := by
    convert (analyticAt_reciprocalY L).const_smul (c := (2 : ℂ)) using 1
    ext z
    simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hderiv : deriv (reciprocalX L) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun z ↦ 2 * reciprocalY L z) :=
    ((analyticAt_reciprocalX L).deriv.frequently_eq_iff_eventually_eq hrhs).mp
      (hpunct.mono fun _ h ↦ h.deriv).frequently
  filter_upwards [(analyticAt_reciprocalX L).eventually_analyticAt, hderiv] with z hz heq
  rw [← heq]
  exact hz.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt

name: Heights.eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalY
statement:
private theorem eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalY (L : PeriodPair) :
    ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 0, HasDerivAt (reciprocalY L)
      (1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L z ^ 2 -
        L.g₃ * reciprocalX L z ^ 3) z
proof:
:= by
  have hpunct : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, HasDerivAt (reciprocalY L)
      (1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L z ^ 2 -
        L.g₃ * reciprocalX L z ^ 3) z := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_reciprocal_nonzero L,
      mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds 0),
      self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hP hzL hz0
    have hz : z ≠ 0 := by simpa using hz0
    have hnot : z ∉ L.lattice := by simp_all
    have hp : HasDerivAt L.weierstrassP (L.derivWeierstrassP z) z := by
      rw [← L.deriv_weierstrassP]
      exact (L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hnot).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hpp : HasDerivAt L.derivWeierstrassP
        (6 * L.weierstrassP z ^ 2 - L.g₂ / 2) z := by
      rw [← deriv_derivWeierstrassP L z hnot]
      exact (L.analyticOnNhd_derivWeierstrassP z hnot).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have heq : reciprocalY L =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        fun w ↦ -L.derivWeierstrassP w / (2 * L.weierstrassP w ^ 2) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact reciprocalY_eq L w hw
    have hden : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ 2 * L.weierstrassP w ^ 2)
        (2 * (2 * L.weierstrassP z * L.derivWeierstrassP z)) z := by
      have hd := HasDerivAt.const_mul 2 (hp.pow 2)
      norm_num at hd
      simpa only [Pi.pow_apply] using hd
    have hfrac := hpp.neg.div hden (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero _ hP))
    have hi := hfrac.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
    have hx : reciprocalX L z = (L.weierstrassP z)⁻¹ :=
      reciprocalX_eq_inv L z hz
    have hval :
        ((-(6 * L.weierstrassP z ^ 2 - L.g₂ / 2)) *
              (2 * L.weierstrassP z ^ 2) -
            (-L.derivWeierstrassP z) *
              (2 * (2 * L.weierstrassP z * L.derivWeierstrassP z))) /
            (2 * L.weierstrassP z ^ 2) ^ 2 =
          1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L z ^ 2 -
            L.g₃ * reciprocalX L z ^ 3 := by
      rw [hx]
      field_simp
      ring_nf
      rw [L.derivWeierstrassP_sq z hnot]
      ring
    rw [← hval]
    exact hi
  have hrhs : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦
      1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L z ^ 2 -
        L.g₃ * reciprocalX L z ^ 3) 0 := by
    have hx := analyticAt_reciprocalX L
    fun_prop
  have hderiv : deriv (reciprocalY L) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] (fun z ↦
      1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L z ^ 2 -
        L.g₃ * reciprocalX L z ^ 3) :=
    ((analyticAt_reciprocalY L).deriv.frequently_eq_iff_eventually_eq hrhs).mp
      (hpunct.mono fun _ h ↦ h.deriv).frequently
  filter_upwards [(analyticAt_reciprocalY L).eventually_analyticAt, hderiv] with z hz heq
  rw [← heq]
  exact hz.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt

name: Heights.eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalState
statement:
private theorem eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalState (L : PeriodPair) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0,
      HasDerivAt (reciprocalState L)
        (reciprocalV L (reciprocalState L t)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalX L).filter_mono
    Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto
  have hy := (eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalY L).filter_mono
    Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto
  filter_upwards [hx, hy] with t hxt hyt
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ Complex.ofRealCLM s) 1 t :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ (reciprocalX L (Complex.ofRealCLM s),
      reciprocalY L (Complex.ofRealCLM s)))
    (2 * reciprocalY L (Complex.ofRealCLM t),
      1 - 3 * L.g₂ / 4 * reciprocalX L (Complex.ofRealCLM t) ^ 2 -
        L.g₃ * reciprocalX L (Complex.ofRealCLM t) ^ 3) t
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_one] using
    (hxt.comp t hinner).prodMk (hyt.comp t hinner)

name: Heights.reciprocalState_eventuallyEq
proof:
:= by
  have hV : ContDiff ℝ 1 (reciprocalV L) := by
    unfold reciprocalV
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hVs⟩ := hV.contDiffAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
      (x := reciprocalState L 0)
  let S : ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun _ ↦ s
  have hv : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, LipschitzOnWith K (reciprocalV L) (S t) :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ hVs
  have hLmem : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, reciprocalState L t ∈ s := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (reciprocalState L) 0 := by
      unfold reciprocalState
      exact ((analyticAt_reciprocalX L).continuousAt.comp_of_eq
        Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt (by norm_num)).prodMk
        ((analyticAt_reciprocalY L).continuousAt.comp_of_eq
          Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt (by norm_num))
    exact hc.preimage_mem_nhds (by simpa [reciprocalState] using hs)
  have hbase : reciprocalState M 0 = reciprocalState L 0 := by
    simp [reciprocalState]
  have hMmem : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, reciprocalState M t ∈ s := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (reciprocalState M) 0 := by
      unfold reciprocalState
      exact ((analyticAt_reciprocalX M).continuousAt.comp_of_eq
        Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt (by norm_num)).prodMk
        ((analyticAt_reciprocalY M).continuousAt.comp_of_eq
          Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt (by norm_num))
    rw [← hbase] at hs
    exact hc.preimage_mem_nhds hs
  apply ODE_solution_unique_of_eventually (v := fun _ ↦ reciprocalV L) (s := S) hv
  · filter_upwards [eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalState L, hLmem] with t ht hm
    exact ⟨ht, hm⟩
  · filter_upwards [eventually_hasDerivAt_reciprocalState M, hMmem] with t ht hm
    have hVL : reciprocalV M = reciprocalV L := by
      funext q
      simp [reciprocalV, h₂, h₃]
    rw [← hVL]
    exact ⟨ht, hm⟩
  · simp [reciprocalState]

name: Heights.frequently_eq_of_eventuallyEq_ofReal
statement:
private theorem frequently_eq_of_eventuallyEq_ofReal {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (h : (fun t : ℝ ↦ f (Complex.ofRealCLM t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (Complex.ofRealCLM t))) :
    ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, f z = g z
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun n ↦ Complex.ofRealCLM (r n)
  have hr_lim : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [r] using (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))
  have hu_lim : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hr_lim
  have hu_ne : ∀ n, u n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n
    dsimp [u, r]
    intro hn
    have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hn
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
    exact (one_div_ne_zero (by positivity)) hre
  have hu_lim' : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℂ)) :=
    tendsto_inf.2 ⟨hu_lim, tendsto_principal.2 (Eventually.of_forall hu_ne)⟩
  have heq : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, f (u n) = g (u n) := by
    filter_upwards [h.filter_mono hr_lim] with n hn
    exact hn
  rw [frequently_iff]
  intro q hq
  have hq' : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, u n ∈ q := hu_lim' hq
  obtain ⟨n, hn, heqn⟩ := (hq'.and heq).exists
  exact ⟨u n, hn, heqn⟩

name: Heights.reciprocalX_eventuallyEq
proof:
:= by
  have hstate := reciprocalState_eventuallyEq L M h₂ h₃
  have hreal : (fun t : ℝ ↦ reciprocalX L (Complex.ofRealCLM t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ reciprocalX M (Complex.ofRealCLM t)) :=
    hstate.mono fun _ h ↦ congr_arg Prod.fst h
  exact ((analyticAt_reciprocalX L).frequently_eq_iff_eventually_eq
    (analyticAt_reciprocalX M)).mp
      (frequently_eq_of_eventuallyEq_ofReal hreal)

name: Heights.weierstrassP_eqOn_compl_lattices
statement:
private theorem weierstrassP_eqOn_compl_lattices (L M : PeriodPair)
    (h₂ : L.g₂ = M.g₂) (h₃ : L.g₃ = M.g₃) :
    Set.EqOn L.weierstrassP M.weierstrassP
      ((L.lattice : Set ℂ) ∪ (M.lattice : Set ℂ))ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  let D : Set ℂ := (L.lattice : Set ℂ) ∪ (M.lattice : Set ℂ) ∪ {0}
  have hLc : (L.lattice : Set ℂ).Countable :=
    countable_of_Lindelof_of_discrete (X := L.lattice)
  have hMc : (M.lattice : Set ℂ).Countable :=
    countable_of_Lindelof_of_discrete (X := M.lattice)
  have hDc : D.Countable := (hLc.union hMc).union (countable_singleton 0)
  have hx := reciprocalX_eventuallyEq L M h₂ h₃
  have hxmem : {z : ℂ | reciprocalX L z = reciprocalX M z} ∈ 𝓝 0 := hx
  obtain ⟨O, hOsub, hOopen, h0O⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hxmem
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀D, hz₀O⟩ := (hDc.dense_compl ℝ).exists_mem_open hOopen ⟨0, h0O⟩
  have hz₀0 : z₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    subst z₀
    exact hz₀D (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton 0))
  have hz₀L : z₀ ∉ L.lattice := by
    intro hz
    exact hz₀D (Or.inl (Or.inl hz))
  have hz₀M : z₀ ∉ M.lattice := by
    intro hz
    exact hz₀D (Or.inl (Or.inr hz))
  have hPgerm : L.weierstrassP =ᶠ[𝓝 z₀] M.weierstrassP := by
    filter_upwards [hOopen.mem_nhds hz₀O, isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz₀0] with z hzO hz0
    have hq := hOsub hzO
    change reciprocalX L z = reciprocalX M z at hq
    rw [reciprocalX_eq_inv L z hz0, reciprocalX_eq_inv M z hz0] at hq
    exact inv_inj.mp hq
  let U : Set ℂ := ((L.lattice : Set ℂ) ∪ (M.lattice : Set ℂ))ᶜ
  have hUpre : IsPreconnected U :=
    (Set.Countable.isConnected_compl_of_one_lt_rank (by simp) (hLc.union hMc)).2
  have hLa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ L.weierstrassP U := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∉ L.lattice ∧ z ∉ M.lattice := by simpa [U] using hz
    exact L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hz'.1
  have hMa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M.weierstrassP U := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∉ L.lattice ∧ z ∉ M.lattice := by simpa [U] using hz
    exact M.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hz'.2
  exact hLa.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hMa hUpre
    (by simpa [U] using ⟨hz₀L, hz₀M⟩) hPgerm

name: Heights.periodPair_lattice_eq_of_g₂_eq_g₃_eq
statement:
theorem periodPair_lattice_eq_of_g₂_eq_g₃_eq (L M : PeriodPair)
    (h₂ : L.g₂ = M.g₂) (h₃ : L.g₃ = M.g₃) :
    L.lattice = M.lattice
proof:
:= by
  have hP := weierstrassP_eqOn_compl_lattices L M h₂ h₃
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    by_contra hzM
    let l : L.lattice := ⟨z, hz⟩
    have heq : L.weierstrassP =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] z] M.weierstrassP := by
      filter_upwards [mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds
          (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds z),
        mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (M.isClosed_lattice.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzM),
        self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hwL hwM hwz
      apply hP
      simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_union, not_or]
      constructor
      · intro hw
        exact hwL ⟨hw, by simpa using hwz⟩
      · exact hwM
    have hLlim := tendsto_sq_mul_weierstrassP_at_lattice L l
    have hsub : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ w - z) (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := by
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ w - z) z := by fun_prop
      simpa using hc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hMcont : Tendsto M.weierstrassP (𝓝[≠] z)
        (𝓝 (M.weierstrassP z)) :=
      (M.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hzM).continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hMlim : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ (w - z) ^ 2 * M.weierstrassP w)
        (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (hsub.pow 2).mul hMcont
    have hsame : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ (w - z) ^ 2 * L.weierstrassP w)
        (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := hMlim.congr' <| heq.mono fun w hw ↦ by
      rw [← hw]
    have : (1 : ℂ) = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hLlim hsame
    norm_num at this
  · intro z hz
    by_contra hzL
    let l : M.lattice := ⟨z, hz⟩
    have heq : M.weierstrassP =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] z] L.weierstrassP := by
      filter_upwards [mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds
          (M.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds z),
        mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (L.isClosed_lattice.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzL),
        self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hwM hwL hwz
      symm
      apply hP
      simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_union, not_or]
      constructor
      · exact hwL
      · intro hw
        exact hwM ⟨hw, by simpa using hwz⟩
    have hMlim := tendsto_sq_mul_weierstrassP_at_lattice M l
    have hsub : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ w - z) (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := by
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ w - z) z := by fun_prop
      simpa using hc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hLcont : Tendsto L.weierstrassP (𝓝[≠] z)
        (𝓝 (L.weierstrassP z)) :=
      (L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP z hzL).continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hLlim : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ (w - z) ^ 2 * L.weierstrassP w)
        (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (hsub.pow 2).mul hLcont
    have hsame : Tendsto (fun w : ℂ ↦ (w - z) ^ 2 * M.weierstrassP w)
        (𝓝[≠] z) (𝓝 0) := hLlim.congr' <| heq.mono fun w hw ↦ by
      rw [← hw]
    have : (1 : ℂ) = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hMlim hsame
    norm_num at this

name: Heights.absNorm_pos_of_ne_bot

name: Heights.logIdealNorm_top

name: Heights.silvermanHeight_periodData_independent
statement:
theorem silvermanHeight_periodData_independent
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (m : GlobalMinimalDiscriminantData K W)
    (p q : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) :
    silvermanHeight W m p = silvermanHeight W m q
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      (∑ v : InfinitePlace K,
        (v.mult : ℝ) * Real.log
          (‖silvermanModularDiscriminant (p.τ v)‖ * (p.τ v).im ^ 6)) =
      ∑ v : InfinitePlace K,
        (v.mult : ℝ) * Real.log
          (‖silvermanModularDiscriminant (q.τ v)‖ * (q.τ v).im ^ 6) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _hv
    have hj : modularJ (p.τ v) = modularJ (q.τ v) :=
      (p.j_eq v).symm.trans (q.j_eq v)
    rw [silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_mul_im_pow_eq_of_modularJ_eq
      (p.τ v) (q.τ v) hj]
  rw [silvermanHeight, silvermanHeight, hsum]

name: Heights.silvermanHeightOfPeriods_eq_silvermanHeightOfCurve
statement:
theorem silvermanHeightOfPeriods_eq_silvermanHeightOfCurve
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) :
    silvermanHeightOfPeriods W p = silvermanHeightOfCurve W
proof:
:=
  silvermanHeight_periodData_independent W (globalMinimalDiscriminantData W)
    p (archimedeanPeriodData W)

name: Heights.silvermanHeight_archimedean_log_arg_pos
statement:
theorem silvermanHeight_archimedean_log_arg_pos
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve K) [W.IsElliptic]
    (p : ArchimedeanPeriodData K W) (v : InfinitePlace K) :
    0 < ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant (p.τ v)‖ * (p.τ v).im ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_pos (silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_pos _)
    (pow_pos (p.τ v).im_pos _)

name: Heights.silvermanHeight_denominator_pos
statement:
theorem silvermanHeight_denominator_pos
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    (0 : ℝ) < 12 * Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:

name: Heights.normSq_mul_add_ge
statement:
theorem normSq_mul_add_ge (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) (a b : ℝ) :
    (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / 2 ≤ Complex.normSq ((a : ℂ) * τ + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hτ
  have hre : |(τ : ℂ).re| ≤ 1 / 2 := h2
  have hns : 1 ≤ (τ : ℂ).re ^ 2 + (τ : ℂ).im ^ 2 := by
    simpa [Complex.normSq_apply, sq] using h1
  have hab : |2 * a * b * (τ : ℂ).re| ≤ |a * b| := by
    rw [show 2 * a * b * (τ : ℂ).re = (a * b) * (2 * (τ : ℂ).re) by ring, abs_mul]
    have : |2 * (τ : ℂ).re| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_mul]; norm_num; linarith
    calc |a * b| * |2 * (τ : ℂ).re| ≤ |a * b| * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |a * b| := mul_one _
  have hsq : 2 * |a * b| ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|a| - |b|), sq_abs a, sq_abs b]
  have heq : Complex.normSq ((a : ℂ) * τ + b) =
      a ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ).re ^ 2 + (τ : ℂ).im ^ 2) + 2 * a * b * (τ : ℂ).re + b ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have := neg_abs_le (2 * a * b * (τ : ℂ).re)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg a]

name: Heights.norm_mul_add_sq_ge
statement:
theorem norm_mul_add_sq_ge (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) (a b : ℝ) :
    (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / 2 ≤ ‖(a : ℂ) * τ + b‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  exact normSq_mul_add_ge hτ a b

name: Heights.one_le_norm_of_mem_fd
statement: theorem one_le_norm_of_mem_fd (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) : 1 ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h : 1 ≤ Complex.normSq (τ : ℂ) := hτ.1
  rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (τ : ℂ)]

name: Heights.norm_le_im_add_half
statement: theorem norm_le_im_add_half (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) : ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ≤ τ.im + 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hre : |(τ : ℂ).re| ≤ 1 / 2 := hτ.2
  calc ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ≤ |(τ : ℂ).re| + |(τ : ℂ).im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 + τ.im := by
      gcongr
      rw [UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, abs_of_pos τ.im_pos]
    _ = τ.im + 1 / 2 := add_comm _ _

name: Heights.summable_latticeSumThree
statement: lemma summable_latticeSumThree : Summable fun x : Fin 2 → ℤ => ‖x‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  EisensteinSeries.summable_one_div_norm_rpow (by norm_num)

name: Heights.latticeSumThree_nonneg
statement: lemma latticeSumThree_nonneg : 0 ≤ latticeSumThree
proof:
:=
  tsum_nonneg fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _

name: Heights.coe_eq_latticeCoords
statement:
lemma coe_eq_latticeCoords (l : (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice) :
    (l : ℂ) = ((latticeCoords τ l 0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * τ + ((latticeCoords τ l 1 : ℤ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).latticeEquiv_symm_apply
    ((periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).latticeEquivProd l)
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  simp [latticeCoords]

name: Heights.norm_weierstrassP_term_le
statement:
lemma norm_weierstrassP_term_le (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) {a b : ℝ} (ha : |a| ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hb : |b| ≤ 1 / 2) (l : (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice)
    (hl : latticeCoords τ l ≠ 0) :
    ‖1 / ((a : ℂ) * τ + b - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2‖ ≤
      80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * ‖latticeCoords τ l‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  set x := latticeCoords τ l with hx
  set m : ℤ := x 0
  set n : ℤ := x 1
  set s : ℝ := ‖x‖ with hs
  have hsmax : s = max (m.natAbs : ℝ) (n.natAbs : ℝ) := by
    rw [hs, EisensteinSeries.norm_eq_max_natAbs]; push_cast; rfl
  have hmax : max |(m : ℝ)| |(n : ℝ)| = s := by
    rw [hsmax, Nat.cast_natAbs, Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs, Int.cast_abs]
  have hm : |(m : ℝ)| ≤ s := hmax ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have hn : |(n : ℝ)| ≤ s := hmax ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := by
    have : x ≠ 0 := hl
    rw [hsmax]
    have hmn : m ≠ 0 ∨ n ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      rw [not_or, not_not, not_not] at h
      apply this
      funext i; fin_cases i
      · exact h.1
      · exact h.2
    rcases hmn with h | h
    · exact le_max_of_le_left (by exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h)
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (by exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h)
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hlc : (l : ℂ) = (m : ℂ) * τ + n := coe_eq_latticeCoords l
  have hτ1 := one_le_norm_of_mem_fd hτ
  set z : ℂ := (a : ℂ) * τ + b with hz
  
  have hzl : s ^ 2 / 8 ≤ ‖z - l‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := norm_mul_add_sq_ge hτ (a - m) (b - n)
    have heq : z - (l : ℂ) = ((a - m : ℝ) : ℂ) * τ + ((b - n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hz, hlc]; push_cast; ring
    rw [heq]
    refine le_trans ?_ h
    rcases le_total |(n : ℝ)| |(m : ℝ)| with hmn | hmn
    · have hms : |(m : ℝ)| = s := by rw [← hmax, max_eq_left hmn]
      have : s / 2 ≤ |a - m| := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (m : ℝ) a
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at this
        linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b - n), abs_nonneg (a - m), sq_abs (a - m)]
    · have hns : |(n : ℝ)| = s := by rw [← hmax, max_eq_right hmn]
      have : s / 2 ≤ |b - n| := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (n : ℝ) b
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at this
        linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - m), abs_nonneg (b - n), sq_abs (b - n)]
  have hl2 : s ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := norm_mul_add_sq_ge hτ m n
    rw [hlc]
    push_cast at h
    refine le_trans ?_ h
    rcases le_total |(n : ℝ)| |(m : ℝ)| with hmn | hmn
    · have hms : |(m : ℝ)| = s := by rw [← hmax, max_eq_left hmn]
      nlinarith [sq_abs (m : ℝ), sq_nonneg (n : ℝ)]
    · have hns : |(n : ℝ)| = s := by rw [← hmax, max_eq_right hmn]
      nlinarith [sq_abs (n : ℝ), sq_nonneg (m : ℝ)]
  
  have hlup : ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by
    rw [hlc]
    calc ‖(m : ℂ) * τ + n‖ ≤ |(m : ℝ)| * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ + |(n : ℝ)| := by
          refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
          rw [norm_mul]
          simp [Complex.norm_intCast]
      _ ≤ s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ + s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by gcongr; nlinarith
      _ = 2 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by ring
  have hzup : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by
    calc ‖z‖ ≤ |a| * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ + |b| := by
          rw [hz]
          refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
          rw [norm_mul]
          simp [Complex.norm_real]
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ + 1 / 2 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by linarith
  have hzl0 : z - l ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hzl; nlinarith
  have hl0 : (l : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hl2; nlinarith
  have hkey : 1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2 = z * (2 * l - z) / ((z - l) ^ 2 * l ^ 2) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [hkey, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow]
  have h2l : ‖2 * (l : ℂ) - z‖ ≤ 5 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by
    calc ‖2 * (l : ℂ) - z‖ ≤ 2 * ‖(l : ℂ)‖ + ‖z‖ := by
          refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_; rw [norm_mul]; norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖) + ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 5 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := by nlinarith
  have hrpow : ‖x‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ) = 1 / s ^ 3 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (norm_nonneg _), ← hs]
    norm_num
  rw [hrpow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have hden : s ^ 4 / 16 ≤ ‖z - l‖ ^ 2 * ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul hzl hl2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  calc ‖z‖ * ‖2 * (l : ℂ) - z‖ ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ * (5 * s * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * (1 / s ^ 3) * (s ^ 4 / 16) := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * (1 / s ^ 3) * (‖z - l‖ ^ 2 * ‖(l : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) := by gcongr

name: Heights.norm_weierstrassP_le
statement:
theorem norm_weierstrassP_le (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) {a b : ℝ} (ha : |a| ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hb : |b| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ‖(periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).weierstrassP ((a : ℂ) * τ + b)‖ ≤
      1 / ‖(a : ℂ) * τ + b‖ ^ 2 + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * latticeSumThree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L := periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ
  set z : ℂ := (a : ℂ) * τ + b with hz
  set E := latticeCoords τ
  set f : L.lattice → ℂ := fun l => 1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / (l : ℂ) ^ 2 with hf
  set g : L.lattice → ℝ := fun l =>
    (if l = E.symm 0 then 1 / ‖z‖ ^ 2 else 0) + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * ‖E l‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ) with hg
  have hE0 : ((E.symm 0 : L.lattice) : ℂ) = 0 := by
    rw [coe_eq_latticeCoords]; simp [E]
  have hbound : ∀ l, ‖f l‖ ≤ g l := by
    intro l
    by_cases hl : l = E.symm 0
    · have hl' : (l : ℂ) = 0 := by rw [hl, hE0]
      have hEl : E l = 0 := by rw [hl, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      simp only [hf, hg, if_pos hl, hl', sub_zero, hEl, norm_zero]
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num), mul_zero, add_zero]
      simp
    · have hEl : E l ≠ 0 := fun h => hl (by rw [← h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
      simp only [hf, hg, if_neg hl, zero_add]
      exact norm_weierstrassP_term_le hτ ha hb l hEl
  have hsg : Summable g := by
    refine Summable.add ?_ ?_
    · exact summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ((Set.finite_singleton (E.symm 0)).subset (by
        intro l hl; by_contra h; exact hl (if_neg h)))
    · exact (E.summable_iff.mpr summable_latticeSumThree).mul_left _
  have hsf : Summable fun l => ‖f l‖ :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hbound hsg
  have htsum : ∑' l, g l = 1 / ‖z‖ ^ 2 + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * latticeSumThree := by
    rw [hg, Summable.tsum_add, tsum_ite_eq, tsum_mul_left]
    · congr 2
      exact E.tsum_eq (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ))
    · exact summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ((Set.finite_singleton (E.symm 0)).subset (by
        intro l hl; by_contra h; exact hl (if_neg h)))
    · exact (E.summable_iff.mpr summable_latticeSumThree).mul_left _
  calc ‖L.weierstrassP z‖ = ‖∑' l, f l‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑' l, ‖f l‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hsf
    _ ≤ ∑' l, g l := Summable.tsum_le_tsum hbound hsf hsg
    _ = _ := htsum

name: Heights.norm_weierstrassP_torsion_le
statement:
theorem norm_weierstrassP_torsion_le (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {z : ℂ}
    (hNz : (N : ℂ) * z ∈ (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice)
    (hz : z ∉ (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice) :
    ‖(periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).weierstrassP z‖ ≤
      2 * N ^ 2 + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * latticeSumThree
proof:
:= by
  set L := periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ
  obtain ⟨m, n, hmn⟩ := PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mp hNz
  have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  set a₀ : ℝ := m / N
  set b₀ : ℝ := n / N
  set k : ℤ := round a₀
  set k' : ℤ := round b₀
  set a : ℝ := a₀ - k
  set b : ℝ := b₀ - k'
  have ha : |a| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_sub_round a₀
  have hb : |b| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_sub_round b₀
  have hzab : z = ((a : ℂ) * τ + b) + ((k : ℂ) * τ + k') := by
    have hN0' : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN0
    have : z = (m / N : ℂ) * τ + (n / N : ℂ) := by
      field_simp
      have h2 : (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).ω₂ = 1 := rfl
      rw [h2, mul_one] at hmn
      rw [mul_comm, ← hmn]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    simp only [a, b, a₀, b₀]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hkmem : ((k : ℂ) * τ + k') ∈ L.lattice :=
    PeriodPair.mem_lattice.mpr ⟨k, k', by simp [L, periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane]⟩
  have hP : L.weierstrassP z = L.weierstrassP ((a : ℂ) * τ + b) := by
    rw [hzab]
    exact L.weierstrassP_add_coe _ ⟨_, hkmem⟩
  rw [hP]
  refine (norm_weierstrassP_le hτ ha hb).trans ?_
  gcongr
  
  have hNa : (N : ℝ) * a = m - N * k := by simp only [a, a₀]; field_simp
  have hNb : (N : ℝ) * b = n - N * k' := by simp only [b, b₀]; field_simp
  have hab : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N * a) ^ 2 + (N * b) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hNa, hNb]
    have hne : m - N * k ≠ 0 ∨ n - N * k' ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      rw [not_or, not_not, not_not] at h
      apply hz
      have ha0 : a = 0 := by
        have : (N : ℝ) * a = 0 := by rw [hNa]; exact_mod_cast h.1
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hN0
      have hb0 : b = 0 := by
        have : (N : ℝ) * b = 0 := by rw [hNb]; exact_mod_cast h.2
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hN0
      rw [hzab, ha0, hb0]
      simpa using hkmem
    rcases hne with h | h
    · have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((m - N * k : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have := Int.one_le_abs h
        have h' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((m - N * k : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        nlinarith [sq_abs ((m - N * k : ℤ) : ℝ)]
      push_cast at this
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((n : ℝ) - N * k')]
    · have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n - N * k' : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have := Int.one_le_abs h
        have h' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((n - N * k' : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        nlinarith [sq_abs ((n - N * k' : ℤ) : ℝ)]
      push_cast at this
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((m : ℝ) - N * k)]
  have hlow := norm_mul_add_sq_ge hτ a b
  have hpos : 0 < ‖(a : ℂ) * τ + b‖ ^ 2 := by
    have : 0 < (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / 2 := by
      have : 0 < (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by nlinarith
      have := pos_of_mul_pos_right this (by positivity)
      positivity
    linarith
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: Heights.exists_weierstrassP_of_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_weierstrassP_of_torsion {τ : ℍ} {W' : WeierstrassCurve ℂ}
    (hW' : W' = latticeWeierstrassCurve τ) {N : ℕ} {x y : ℂ}
    (h : W'.toAffine.Nonsingular x y)
    (hP : N • (Affine.Point.some x y h : W'.toAffine.Point) = 0) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, z ∉ (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice ∧
      (N : ℂ) * z ∈ (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice ∧
      x = (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).weierstrassP z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  subst hW'
  set e := latticeQuotientPointMapAddEquiv τ
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective (e.symm (Affine.Point.some x y h))
  have hez : e (QuotientAddGroup.mk z) = Affine.Point.some x y h := by
    rw [hz, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hmap : e (QuotientAddGroup.mk z) = latticePointMap τ z := rfl
  have hzL : z ∉ (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).lattice := by
    intro hzL
    rw [hmap, latticePointMap_of_mem τ z hzL] at hez
    exact Affine.Point.some_ne_zero h hez.symm
  refine ⟨z, hzL, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : e (N • (QuotientAddGroup.mk z : LatticeQuotient τ)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_nsmul, hez, hP]
    have h1 : N • (QuotientAddGroup.mk z : LatticeQuotient τ) = 0 :=
      e.injective (h0.trans (map_zero e).symm)
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.mk_nsmul, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff] at h1
    simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using h1
  · rw [hmap, latticePointMap_of_notMem τ z hzL, latticeAffinePoint] at hez
    exact (Affine.Point.some.inj hez).1.symm

name: Heights.norm_x_sub_r_le
statement:
theorem norm_x_sub_r_le {W : WeierstrassCurve ℂ} [W.IsElliptic] {τ : ℍ} (hτ : τ ∈ ModularGroup.fd)
    {C : VariableChange ℂ} (hC : C • W = latticeWeierstrassCurve τ) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {x y : ℂ} (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y)
    (hP : N • (Affine.Point.some x y h : W.toAffine.Point) = 0) :
    ‖x - C.r‖ ≤ ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * (2 * N ^ 2 + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * latticeSumThree)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P' := (C.pointAddEquiv W).symm (Affine.Point.some x y h) with hP'
  have hP'0 : N • P' = 0 := by rw [hP', ← map_nsmul, hP, map_zero]
  have hP'eq : P' = C.inversePointMap W (Affine.Point.some x y h) := rfl
  rw [VariableChange.inversePointMap_some] at hP'eq
  rw [hP'eq] at hP'0
  obtain ⟨z, hzL, hNz, hx⟩ := exists_weierstrassP_of_torsion hC _ hP'0
  have hxr : x - C.r = (C.u : ℂ) ^ 2 * (periodPairOfUpperHalfPlane τ).weierstrassP z := by
    rw [← hx, VariableChange.inverseX]
    field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  rw [hxr, norm_mul, norm_pow]
  gcongr
  exact norm_weierstrassP_torsion_le hτ hN hNz hzL

name: Heights.exists_torsion_x_bound
statement:
theorem exists_torsion_x_bound :
    ∃ A B : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℂ) [W.IsElliptic] {N : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N →
      ∀ {x y : ℂ} (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y),
        N • (Affine.Point.some x y h : W.toAffine.Point) = 0 →
        ‖x + W.b₂ / 12‖ ^ 6 ≤ A * ‖W.Δ‖ * max ‖W.j‖ 1 *
          (2 * N ^ 2 + B * (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) + 1) ^ 2) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CΔ, hCΔ0, hCΔ⟩ := modularDeltaJ_fd_comparison
  obtain ⟨Cy, hCy0, hCy⟩ := modularIm_logLogJ_fd_comparison
  refine ⟨Real.exp CΔ, 80 * latticeSumThree * Real.exp Cy ^ 2, (Real.exp_pos _).le,
    by have := latticeSumThree_nonneg; positivity, ?_⟩
  intro W _ N hN x y h hP
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτj⟩ := exists_mem_fd_modularJ_eq_of_surjective modularJ_surjective W.j
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := W.exists_variableChange_of_j_eq (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ)
    (by rw [latticeWeierstrassCurve_j, hτj])
  have hr : C.r = -(W.b₂ / 12) := by
    have hb := variableChange_b₂ W C
    rw [hC] at hb
    have h0 : (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).b₂ = 0 := by
      simp [WeierstrassCurve.b₂, latticeWeierstrassCurve]
    rw [h0] at hb
    have hu : ((C.u⁻¹ : ℂˣ) : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (Units.ne_zero _)
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp hb.symm).resolve_left hu
    linear_combination this / 12
  have hΔ : ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * ‖(latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).Δ‖ = ‖W.Δ‖ := by
    have hd := variableChange_Δ W C
    rw [hC] at hd
    rw [hd, norm_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← norm_pow, ← norm_mul, ← mul_pow, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero C.u), one_pow, norm_one, one_mul]
  have hlat : (latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).Δ = silvermanModularDiscriminant τ := by
    rw [latticeWeierstrassCurve_discriminant_eq_modularDiscriminant, silvermanModularDiscriminant]
    ring
  have hj : modularJ τ = W.j := hτj
  
  have hΔlow : 1 ≤ Real.exp CΔ * max ‖W.j‖ 1 * ‖(latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).Δ‖ := by
    have h1 := hCΔ τ hτ
    rw [hj] at h1
    have hpos : 0 < ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant τ‖ := silvermanModularDiscriminant_norm_pos τ
    have hM : 0 < max ‖W.j‖ 1 := lt_max_of_lt_right one_pos
    have h2 : Real.log (1 / (max ‖W.j‖ 1 * ‖silvermanModularDiscriminant τ‖)) ≤ CΔ := by
      rw [one_div, Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul hM.ne' hpos.ne']
      linarith [(abs_le.mp h1).2]
    have h3 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
    rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity)] at h3
    rw [hlat]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h3
    linarith
  
  have hτnorm : ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp Cy ^ 2 *
      (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := hCy τ hτ
    rw [hj] at h1
    have hL : 1 ≤ Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_max_of_lt_right (Real.exp_pos 1))]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    have him : τ.im ≤ Real.exp Cy * Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) := by
      have h2 : Real.log τ.im ≤ Cy + Real.log (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1))) := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp h1).2]
      have h3 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
      rw [Real.exp_log τ.im_pos, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by linarith)] at h3
      exact h3
    have hn := norm_le_im_add_half hτ
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hle : ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp Cy * (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) + 1) := by
      have : 1 ≤ Real.exp Cy := Real.one_le_exp hCy0
      nlinarith
    calc ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp Cy * (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) + 1)) ^ 2 := by
          gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hmain := norm_x_sub_r_le hτ hC hN h hP
  rw [hr, sub_neg_eq_add] at hmain
  set Q : ℝ := 2 * N ^ 2 + 80 * ‖(τ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * latticeSumThree with hQ
  set Q' : ℝ := 2 * N ^ 2 + 80 * latticeSumThree * Real.exp Cy ^ 2 *
    (Real.log (max ‖W.j‖ (Real.exp 1)) + 1) ^ 2 with hQ'
  have hQle : Q ≤ Q' := by
    have := latticeSumThree_nonneg
    rw [hQ, hQ']
    nlinarith
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by have := latticeSumThree_nonneg; positivity
  have h6 : ‖x + W.b₂ / 12‖ ^ 6 ≤ ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * Q ^ 6 := by
    calc ‖x + W.b₂ / 12‖ ^ 6 ≤ (‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 * Q) ^ 6 := by gcongr
      _ = ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * Q ^ 6 := by ring
  calc ‖x + W.b₂ / 12‖ ^ 6 ≤ ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * Q ^ 6 := h6
    _ ≤ ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * (Real.exp CΔ * max ‖W.j‖ 1 * ‖(latticeWeierstrassCurve τ).Δ‖) *
        Q ^ 6 := by
      have : 0 ≤ ‖(C.u : ℂ)‖ ^ 12 * Q ^ 6 := by positivity
      nlinarith
    _ = Real.exp CΔ * ‖W.Δ‖ * max ‖W.j‖ 1 * Q ^ 6 := by rw [← hΔ]; ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp CΔ * ‖W.Δ‖ * max ‖W.j‖ 1 * Q' ^ 6 := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [hQ']

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_equation_iff
statement:
theorem variableChange_equation_iff (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (C : VariableChange F) (x y : F) :
    (C • W).toAffine.Equation x y ↔
      W.toAffine.Equation (C.u ^ 2 * x + C.r)
        (C.u ^ 3 * y + C.u ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff, Affine.equation_iff]
  simp only [variableChange_a₁, variableChange_a₂, variableChange_a₃,
    variableChange_a₄, variableChange_a₆, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.forward_inverseX
statement:
@[simp] theorem forward_inverseX (x : F) :
    (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.inverseX x + C.r = x

:= by
  simp only [inverseX]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.forward_inverseY
statement:
@[simp] theorem forward_inverseY (x y : F) :
    (C.u : F) ^ 3 * C.inverseY x y +
        (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * C.inverseX x + C.t = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inverseX, inverseY]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.inverseX_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseX_forward (x : F) :
    C.inverseX ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x + C.r) = x

:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.inverseY_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseY_forward (x y : F) :
    C.inverseY ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inverseY]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.negY_forward
statement:
theorem negY_forward (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (x y : F) :
    W.toAffine.negY ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t) =
      (C.u : F) ^ 3 * (C • W).toAffine.negY x y +
        (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Affine.negY, variableChange_a₁, variableChange_a₃,
    Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.addX_forward
statement:
theorem addX_forward (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (x₁ x₂ ℓ : F) :
    W.toAffine.addX ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r) ((C.u : F) * ℓ + C.s) =
      (C.u : F) ^ 2 * (C • W).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ℓ + C.r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Affine.addX, variableChange_a₁, variableChange_a₂,
    Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.addY_forward
statement:
theorem addY_forward (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (x₁ x₂ y₁ ℓ : F) :
    W.toAffine.addY ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t)
        ((C.u : F) * ℓ + C.s) =
      (C.u : F) ^ 3 * (C • W).toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ ℓ +
        (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * (C • W).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ℓ + C.t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Affine.addY, Affine.negAddY, Affine.negY, Affine.addX,
    variableChange_a₁, variableChange_a₂, variableChange_a₃,
    Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.slope_forward
statement:
theorem slope_forward [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : F)
    (h₁ : (C • W).toAffine.Equation x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : (C • W).toAffine.Equation x₂ y₂)
    (hxy : ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = (C • W).toAffine.negY x₂ y₂)) :
    W.toAffine.slope ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₂ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₂ + C.t) =
      (C.u : F) * (C • W).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ + C.s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x₁ = x₂
  · have hy : y₁ ≠ (C • W).toAffine.negY x₂ y₂ := fun h ↦ hxy ⟨hx, h⟩
    have hy_eq : y₁ = y₂ := Affine.Y_eq_of_Y_ne h₁ h₂ hx hy
    subst x₂
    subst y₂
    have hY :
        (C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t ≠
          W.toAffine.negY ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r)
            ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t) := by
      rw [C.negY_forward W]
      intro h
      apply hy
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 (Units.ne_zero C.u))
      linear_combination h
    have hden : y₁ - (C • W).toAffine.negY x₁ y₁ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
    have hDen :
        ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t) -
          W.toAffine.negY ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r)
            ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t) ≠ 0 :=
      sub_ne_zero.mpr hY
    rw [Affine.slope_of_Y_ne rfl hY, Affine.slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy]
    apply (div_eq_iff hDen).2
    field_simp [hden, Units.ne_zero]
    simp only [Affine.negY, variableChange_a₁, variableChange_a₂,
      variableChange_a₃, variableChange_a₄, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    field_simp [Units.ne_zero]
    ring
  · have hX : (C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r ≠ (C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r := by
      intro h
      apply hx
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 (Units.ne_zero C.u))
      linear_combination h
    rw [Affine.slope_of_X_ne hX, Affine.slope_of_X_ne hx]
    field_simp [Units.ne_zero, hx]
    ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pointMap_zero : C.pointMap W .zero = .zero
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointMap_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointMap_some (x y : F) (h : (C • W).toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    C.pointMap W (.some x y h) =
      .mk ((variableChange_equation_iff W C x y).mp h.1)
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointMap_add
statement:
theorem pointMap_add [DecidableEq F] (P Q : (C • W).toAffine.Point) :
    C.pointMap W (P + Q) = C.pointMap W P + C.pointMap W Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases P with (_ | ⟨x₁, y₁, h₁⟩)
  · rfl
  rcases Q with (_ | ⟨x₂, y₂, h₂⟩)
  · rfl
  let X₁ := (C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r
  let X₂ := (C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r
  let Y₁ := (C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t
  let Y₂ := (C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₂ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₂ + C.t
  by_cases hxy : x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = (C • W).toAffine.negY x₂ y₂
  · have hX : X₁ = X₂ := by simp only [X₁, X₂, hxy.1]
    have hY : Y₁ = W.toAffine.negY X₂ Y₂ := by
      simp only [X₂, Y₁, Y₂]
      rw [C.negY_forward W, hxy.1, hxy.2]
    rw [Affine.Point.add_of_Y_eq hxy.1 hxy.2]
    simp only [pointMap_some, Affine.Point.mk]
    exact (Affine.Point.add_of_Y_eq hX hY).symm
  · have hX_of_eq : X₁ = X₂ → x₁ = x₂ := by
      intro h
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 (Units.ne_zero C.u))
      dsimp only [X₁, X₂] at h
      linear_combination h
    have hXY : ¬(X₁ = X₂ ∧ Y₁ = W.toAffine.negY X₂ Y₂) := by
      rintro ⟨hX, hY⟩
      apply hxy
      have hx := hX_of_eq hX
      refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [X₁, X₂, Y₁, Y₂] at hY
      rw [C.negY_forward W] at hY
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 (Units.ne_zero C.u))
      rw [hx] at hY
      linear_combination hY
    rw [Affine.Point.add_some hxy]
    simp only [pointMap_some, Affine.Point.mk]
    rw [Affine.Point.add_some hXY]
    have hslope := C.slope_forward W x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ h₁.1 h₂.1 hxy
    dsimp only [X₁, X₂, Y₁, Y₂] at hslope ⊢
    rw [Affine.Point.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · rw [hslope, C.addX_forward W]
    · rw [hslope, C.addY_forward W]

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.inversePointMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inversePointMap_zero : C.inversePointMap W .zero = .zero
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.inversePointMap_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem inversePointMap_some (x y : F) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    C.inversePointMap W (.some x y h) =
      .mk ((variableChange_equation_iff W C (C.inverseX x) (C.inverseY x y)).mpr <| by
        simpa using h.1)
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointEquiv_apply (P : (C • W).toAffine.Point) :
    C.pointEquiv W P = C.pointMap W P
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointEquiv_symm_apply (P : W.toAffine.Point) :
    (C.pointEquiv W).symm P = C.inversePointMap W P
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointAddEquiv_apply [DecidableEq F]
    (P : (C • W).toAffine.Point) :
    C.pointAddEquiv W P = C.pointMap W P
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.VariableChange.pointAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pointAddEquiv_symm_apply [DecidableEq F]
    (P : W.toAffine.Point) :
